description.en: Anteromedial nucleus of the anterior thalamic group, lying under the anterior tubercle of the thalamus medial to AV.
description.uz: Talamusning oldingi guruhidagi anteromedial yadro; talamusning oldingi do'mbog'i ostida, AV dan medialda joylashgan.

role.en: Part of the Papez circuit: receives the mammillothalamic tract and projects to the anterior and posterior cingulate cortex, supporting episodic memory and spatial navigation.
role.uz: Papez zanjirining qismi: mamillotalamik traktni qabul qilib, oldingi va orqa belbog' po'stlog'iga uzatadi — epizodik xotira va fazoviy mo'ljal.

clinical.en: Anterior thalamic damage (tuberothalamic artery infarct, Korsakoff syndrome) causes diencephalic amnesia; the anterior nucleus is a DBS target in drug-resistant epilepsy (SANTE trial).
clinical.uz: Oldingi talamus zararlanishi (tuberotalamik arteriya infarkti, Korsakov sindromi) diensefal amneziya beradi; oldingi yadro dori-rezistent epilepsiyada DBS nishoni (SANTE tadqiqoti).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: The largest anterior thalamic nucleus, forming the anterior tubercle of the thalamus beneath the floor of the lateral ventricle.
description.uz: Talamusning oldingi yadrolari ichida eng kattasi; yon qorincha tubi ostida talamusning oldingi do'mbog'ini hosil qiladi.

role.en: Main relay of the Papez circuit: mammillary body → mammillothalamic tract → AV → cingulate gyrus; contains head-direction cells.
role.uz: Papez zanjirining asosiy o'tkazgichi: so'rg'ichsimon tana → mamillotalamik trakt → AV → belbog' pushtasi; bosh yo'nalishi hujayralarini saqlaydi.

clinical.en: Target of anterior-nucleus DBS for focal epilepsy; lesioned in thalamic amnesia together with the mammillothalamic tract.
clinical.uz: Fokal epilepsiyada oldingi yadro DBS nishoni; talamik amneziyada mamillotalamik trakt bilan birga zararlanadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: The central lateral nucleus — the anterior intralaminar group embedded in the internal medullary lamina, curving around the mediodorsal nucleus.
description.uz: Markaziy lateral yadro — ichki medullyar plastinkaga joylashgan oldingi intralaminar guruh, mediodorsal yadroni o'rab egilgan.

role.en: Diffusely projects to the cortex and striatum; a key node of the arousal system that keeps the cortex awake and supports attention.
role.uz: Po'stloq va striatumga tarqoq proyeksiya beradi; po'stloqni hushyor saqlovchi va diqqatni ta'minlovchi uyg'onish tizimining asosiy tuguni.

clinical.en: Bilateral intralaminar lesions cause akinetic mutism or coma; central thalamic (CL) stimulation has restored behaviour in minimally conscious patients.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama intralaminar zararlanish akinetik mutizm yoki koma beradi; markaziy talamus (CL) stimulyatsiyasi minimal ongli bemorlarda xulqni qisman tiklagan.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Centromedian nucleus — the largest posterior intralaminar nucleus, a round cell mass inside the internal medullary lamina below the mediodorsal nucleus.
description.uz: Sentromedian yadro — orqa intralaminar yadrolarning eng kattasi; ichki medullyar plastinka ichida, mediodorsal yadro ostidagi yumaloq hujayra to'plami.

role.en: Receives the internal globus pallidus and motor cortex and projects mainly to the putamen — a feedback loop of the basal ganglia; also part of the ascending arousal system.
role.uz: Ichki rangpar shar va harakat po'stlog'idan kirish oladi, asosan putamenga uzatadi — bazal yadrolarning qayta aloqa halqasi; uyg'onish tizimining ham qismi.

clinical.en: CM–Pf DBS is used for Tourette syndrome and generalized epilepsy (Lennox–Gastaut).
clinical.uz: CM–Pf DBS Turett sindromi va generalizatsiyalangan epilepsiyada (Lennoks–Gasto) qo'llaniladi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Lateral dorsal nucleus — the most anterior nucleus of the lateral group, on the dorsal surface of the thalamus behind the anterior nuclei.
description.uz: Lateral dorsal yadro — lateral guruhning eng oldingi yadrosi; talamusning dorsal yuzasida, oldingi yadrolar ortida.

role.en: Functionally belongs with the anterior (limbic) nuclei: connects with the cingulate gyrus, retrosplenial cortex and precuneus; contributes to spatial memory.
role.uz: Funksional jihatdan oldingi (limbik) yadrolarga yaqin: belbog' pushtasi, retrosplenial po'stloq va precuneus bilan bog'langan; fazoviy xotiraga hissa qo'shadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture
Wikipedia — Lateral dorsal nucleus of thalamus

description.en: Nucleus limitans — a thin cell strip at the border between the posterior thalamus and the pretectum/midbrain.
description.uz: Limitans yadrosi — talamusning orqa qismi bilan pretektum/o'rta miya chegarasidagi yupqa hujayra tasmasi.

role.en: Relays nociceptive and visceral input from the spinothalamic and spinomesencephalic systems toward the insula and striatum.
role.uz: Spinotalamik va spinomezensefalik tizimlardan og'riq va visseral kirishni orolcha va striatum tomon uzatadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Lateral posterior nucleus — lies behind LD and in front of the pulvinar, with which it forms the pulvinar–LP complex.
description.uz: Lateral orqa yadro — LD ortida va pulvinar oldida joylashgan; pulvinar bilan birga pulvinar–LP kompleksini hosil qiladi.

role.en: Higher-order relay linking the superior parietal lobule and precuneus with the superior colliculus; involved in visuospatial integration.
role.uz: Yuqori tartibli o'tkazgich: yuqori tepa bo'lakchasi va precuneusni yuqori do'nglik bilan bog'laydi; ko'ruv-fazoviy integratsiyada ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture
Wikipedia — Lateral posterior nucleus of thalamus

description.en: Mediodorsal nucleus — the large medial thalamic nucleus between the internal medullary lamina and the third ventricle; magnocellular (medial) and parvocellular (lateral) parts.
description.uz: Mediodorsal yadro — ichki medullyar plastinka bilan uchinchi qorincha orasidagi yirik medial yadro; magnoselulyar (medial) va parvoselulyar (lateral) qismlari bor.

role.en: Reciprocal relay of the prefrontal cortex (dorsolateral, orbitofrontal, anterior cingulate) with input from the amygdala, ventral pallidum and olfactory cortex — working memory, decision-making, emotion.
role.uz: Prefrontal po'stloq (dorsolateral, orbitofrontal, oldingi belbog') bilan ikki tomonlama bog'langan; amigdala, ventral pallidum va hid po'stlog'idan kirish oladi — ishchi xotira, qaror qabul qilish, emotsiya.

clinical.en: Paramedian thalamic (artery of Percheron) infarcts involving MD cause amnesia, apathy and frontal-type behaviour change; MD is atrophic in Wernicke–Korsakoff syndrome and implicated in schizophrenia.
clinical.uz: MD ni qamragan paramedian talamik (Percheron arteriyasi) infarktlar amneziya, apatiya va frontal tipdagi xulq o'zgarishi beradi; Vernike–Korsakov sindromida atrofiyalanadi, shizofreniyada ham ahamiyati bor.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Medioventral nucleus (nucleus reuniens) — a midline nucleus in the thalamic wall of the third ventricle, below the mediodorsal nucleus, often joined across the interthalamic adhesion.
description.uz: Medioventral yadro (reuniens yadrosi) — uchinchi qorincha devoridagi o'rta chiziq yadrosi; MD ostida, ko'pincha talamuslararo bitishma orqali qarama-qarshi tomon bilan qo'shiladi.

role.en: Links the medial prefrontal cortex with the hippocampus — coordinates the two during memory consolidation and spatial working memory.
role.uz: Medial prefrontal po'stloqni gippokamp bilan bog'laydi — xotirani mustahkamlash va fazoviy ishchi xotirada ularni muvofiqlashtiradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Parafascicular nucleus — posterior intralaminar nucleus medial to the centromedian nucleus, around the habenulo-interpeduncular (retroflex) tract.
description.uz: Parafassikulyar yadro — sentromedian yadrodan medialda, habenulo-interpedunkulyar (retrofleks) trakt atrofidagi orqa intralaminar yadro.

role.en: Projects to the caudate and associative/limbic striatum; signals salient events and shifts of attention to the basal ganglia.
role.uz: Dumli yadro va assotsiativ/limbik striatumga uzatadi; muhim hodisalar va diqqat almashinuvi haqidagi signalni bazal yadrolarga beradi.

clinical.en: Included in CM–Pf DBS for Tourette syndrome; degenerates early in Parkinson's disease.
clinical.uz: Turett sindromida CM–Pf DBS tarkibiga kiradi; Parkinson kasalligida erta degeneratsiyalanadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Posterior nuclear complex — the posterior thalamus caudal to VPL/VPM and medial to the pulvinar, above the medial geniculate body.
description.uz: Orqa yadrolar kompleksi — VPL/VPM ortida, pulvinardan medialda, medial tizzasimon tana ustidagi talamusning orqa qismi.

role.en: Receives spinothalamic pain and temperature input and projects to the parietal operculum (S2) and posterior insula.
role.uz: Spinotalamik og'riq va harorat kirishini qabul qilib, tepa qopqog'i (S2) va orqa orolchaga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Involved in central post-stroke (Dejerine–Roussy) pain together with VPL/VPM.
clinical.uz: VPL/VPM bilan birga insultdan keyingi markaziy (Dejerin–Russi) og'riqda ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Anterior (oral) pulvinar — the front part of the pulvinar, adjoining the posterior ventral nuclei.
description.uz: Oldingi (oral) pulvinar — pulvinarning oldingi qismi, orqa ventral yadrolarga tutashgan.

role.en: Connected with somatosensory and parietal cortex rather than vision; integrates somatosensory and multisensory information.
role.uz: Ko'rish emas, somatosensor va tepa po'stlog'i bilan bog'langan; somatosensor va ko'p sezgili ma'lumotni integratsiya qiladi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Inferior pulvinar — the ventral part of the pulvinar above the brachium of the superior colliculus.
description.uz: Pastki pulvinar — pulvinarning ventral qismi, yuqori do'nglik yelkasi ustida.

role.en: Retinotopically mapped: links the superior colliculus with extrastriate visual areas (V2–V4, MT) — a route for vision that bypasses V1.
role.uz: Retinotopik tuzilgan: yuqori do'nglikni ekstrastriar ko'ruv maydonlari (V2–V4, MT) bilan bog'laydi — V1 ni chetlab o'tuvchi ko'rish yo'li.

clinical.en: Proposed substrate of 'blindsight' after V1 lesions.
clinical.uz: V1 zararlanishidan keyingi 'ko'r ko'rish' (blindsight) asosi deb hisoblanadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Lateral pulvinar — the dorsolateral part of the pulvinar, next to the lateral geniculate body.
description.uz: Lateral pulvinar — pulvinarning dorsolateral qismi, lateral tizzasimon tana yonida.

role.en: Reciprocally connected with occipital, posterior parietal and temporal visual cortex; regulates visual attention and synchrony between visual areas.
role.uz: Ensa, orqa tepa va chakka ko'ruv po'stlog'i bilan ikki tomonlama bog'langan; ko'ruv diqqati va maydonlar orasidagi sinxronlikni boshqaradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Medial pulvinar — the large medial part of the pulvinar, overhanging the midbrain tectum.
description.uz: Medial pulvinar — pulvinarning katta medial qismi, o'rta miya tektumi ustiga osilib turadi.

role.en: Highest-order associative thalamus: connects with prefrontal, cingulate, insular, temporal and parietal association cortex and the amygdala; involved in attention and salience.
role.uz: Eng yuqori tartibli assotsiativ talamus: prefrontal, belbog', orolcha, chakka va tepa assotsiativ po'stlog'i hamda amigdala bilan bog'langan; diqqat va ahamiyatlilikda ishtirok etadi.

clinical.en: Medial pulvinar DBS is being explored for drug-resistant posterior-quadrant epilepsy; the 'pulvinar sign' on MRI is seen in variant CJD.
clinical.uz: Dori-rezistent orqa kvadrant epilepsiyasida medial pulvinar DBS o'rganilmoqda; MRTdagi 'pulvinar belgisi' variant KYaK (Kreytsfeldt–Yakob) da kuzatiladi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Paraventricular thalamic nucleus — a midline nucleus lining the dorsal third ventricle below the stria medullaris.
description.uz: Talamusning paraventrikulyar yadrosi — stria medullaris ostida uchinchi qorinchaning dorsal devorini qoplaydigan o'rta chiziq yadrosi.

role.en: Receives hypothalamic and brainstem signals about stress, arousal and hunger and projects to the nucleus accumbens, amygdala and BNST — motivation and reward seeking.
role.uz: Gipotalamus va miya ustunidan stress, hushyorlik va ochlik haqida signal olib, accumbens, amigdala va BNST ga uzatadi — motivatsiya va mukofot izlash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture
Wikipedia — Paraventricular nucleus of the thalamus

description.en: Thalamic reticular nucleus — a thin shell of GABAergic neurons wrapping the lateral and anterior surface of the thalamus, between the external medullary lamina and the internal capsule.
description.uz: Talamusning retikulyar yadrosi — talamusning lateral va oldingi yuzasini o'raydigan GABAergik neyronlarning yupqa qobig'i; tashqi medullyar plastinka bilan ichki kapsula orasida.

role.en: Receives collaterals of all thalamocortical and corticothalamic axons and inhibits the relay nuclei — gates attention and generates sleep spindles.
role.uz: Barcha talamokortikal va kortikotalamik aksonlar kollateralini olib, relay yadrolarni tormozlaydi — diqqatni 'darvozalaydi' va uyqu shpindellarini hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: Rhythmic Rt–relay interaction underlies the 3 Hz spike-and-wave of absence epilepsy; spindle deficits are reported in schizophrenia.
clinical.uz: Rt–relay ritmik o'zaro ta'siri absans epilepsiyadagi 3 Gs cho'qqi-to'lqinning asosi; shizofreniyada shpindel yetishmovchiligi qayd etilgan.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Suprageniculate nucleus — a small posterior nucleus above the medial geniculate body, bordering the limitans nucleus.
description.uz: Supragenikulyar yadro — medial tizzasimon tana ustidagi, limitans yadrosiga tutashgan kichik orqa yadro.

role.en: Multisensory (auditory, visual, somatic) relay to the insula and temporal cortex; involved in orienting to novel stimuli.
role.uz: Orolcha va chakka po'stlog'iga ko'p sezgili (eshituv, ko'ruv, somatik) o'tkazgich; yangi stimulga yo'nalishda ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Subparafascicular nucleus — a small cell group just ventral to the parafascicular nucleus, at the junction with the midbrain.
description.uz: Subparafassikulyar yadro — parafassikulyar yadrodan biroz ventralda, o'rta miya bilan chegaradagi kichik hujayra guruhi.

role.en: Relays somatosensory, auditory and visceral information to the striatum and amygdala; involved in pain and social/sexual behaviour in animal studies.
role.uz: Somatosensor, eshituv va visseral ma'lumotni striatum va amigdalaga uzatadi; hayvon tadqiqotlarida og'riq va ijtimoiy/jinsiy xulqda ishtirok etgan.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral anterior nucleus — the most anterior of the ventral tier, just behind the reticular nucleus and in front of VL.
description.uz: Ventral oldingi yadro — ventral qatorning eng oldingisi; retikulyar yadro ortida, VL oldida.

role.en: Basal-ganglia thalamus: receives inhibitory output from the internal globus pallidus and substantia nigra pars reticulata and drives premotor and prefrontal cortex — initiation and selection of movement.
role.uz: Bazal yadrolar talamusi: ichki rangpar shar va qora moddaning retikulyar qismidan tormozlovchi chiqishni olib, premotor va prefrontal po'stloqni harakatga keltiradi — harakatni boshlash va tanlash.

clinical.en: Target of historic and modern pallidothalamic surgery (Forel field H1 / VA–VLA) for Parkinson's disease and dystonia.
clinical.uz: Parkinson kasalligi va distoniyada pallidotalamik jarrohlik (Forel H1 maydoni / VA–VLA) nishoni.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Magnocellular part of the ventral anterior nucleus — its medial, large-celled portion adjacent to the mediodorsal nucleus.
description.uz: Ventral oldingi yadroning magnoselulyar qismi — mediodorsal yadroga yondosh medial, yirik hujayrali bo'lagi.

role.en: Receives the substantia nigra pars reticulata and projects to the frontal eye field and prefrontal cortex — control of eye movements and cognitive loops.
role.uz: Qora moddaning retikulyar qismidan kirish olib, peshona ko'z maydoni va prefrontal po'stloqqa uzatadi — ko'z harakatlari va kognitiv halqalar.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral intermediate nucleus (Hassler's Vim) — the posterior part of the ventral lateral complex, just in front of VPL/VPM.
description.uz: Ventral oraliq yadro (Hassler bo'yicha Vim) — ventral lateral kompleksning orqa qismi, VPL/VPM ning bevosita oldida.

role.en: Cerebellar thalamus: receives the dentato-rubro-thalamic tract (superior cerebellar peduncle) and relays to the primary motor cortex; neurons fire in time with tremor.
role.uz: Miyacha talamusi: dentato-rubro-talamik traktni (yuqori miyacha oyoqchasi) qabul qilib, birlamchi harakat po'stlog'iga uzatadi; neyronlari tremor bilan bir ritmda razryad beradi.

clinical.en: The principal target for essential tremor — DBS, radiofrequency thalamotomy and MR-guided focused ultrasound; typical target ~14 mm lateral to midline (≈11 mm from the third-ventricle wall), 25% of AC–PC length in front of PC.
clinical.uz: Essensial tremorning asosiy nishoni — DBS, radiochastotali talamotomiya va MRT nazoratidagi fokuslangan ultratovush; odatiy nishon o'rta chiziqdan ~14 mm lateral (III qorincha devoridan ≈11 mm), PC dan AC–PC uzunligining 25% oldinda.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral lateral anterior nucleus (Hassler's Voa) — the anterior part of the ventral lateral complex, behind VA.
description.uz: Ventral lateral oldingi yadro (Hassler bo'yicha Voa) — ventral lateral kompleksning oldingi qismi, VA ortida.

role.en: Receives the pallidothalamic fibres (ansa and fasciculus lenticularis via the thalamic fasciculus) and projects to the supplementary motor area and premotor cortex.
role.uz: Pallidotalamik tolalarni (ansa va fasciculus lenticularis, talamik tutam orqali) qabul qilib, qo'shimcha harakat sohasi va premotor po'stloqqa uzatadi.

clinical.en: Target for dystonia and levodopa-induced dyskinesia surgery (pallidal-receiving thalamus).
clinical.uz: Distoniya va levodopa diskineziyasida jarrohlik nishoni (pallidumdan kirish oluvchi talamus).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral lateral posterior nucleus (Hassler's Vop/Vim) — the posterior part of the ventral lateral complex.
description.uz: Ventral lateral orqa yadro (Hassler bo'yicha Vop/Vim) — ventral lateral kompleksning orqa qismi.

role.en: Main cerebellar relay to the primary motor cortex — coordinates the timing and force of voluntary movement.
role.uz: Miyachadan birlamchi harakat po'stlog'iga asosiy o'tkazgich — ixtiyoriy harakat vaqti va kuchini muvofiqlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral ataxia (thalamic ataxia); part of the tremor-surgery target zone with VIM.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda ataksiya (talamik ataksiya) beradi; VIM bilan birga tremor jarrohligi nishon zonasi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral medial nucleus — lies medial to the ventral lateral nuclei at the base of the thalamus.
description.uz: Ventral medial yadro — talamus asosida, ventral lateral yadrolardan medialda joylashgan.

role.en: Receives the substantia nigra pars reticulata and superior colliculus and projects widely to layer I of frontal cortex — broad modulation of motor readiness and arousal.
role.uz: Qora moddaning retikulyar qismi va yuqori do'nglikdan kirish olib, peshona po'stlog'ining I qavatiga keng proyeksiya beradi — harakatga tayyorlik va hushyorlikni keng modulyatsiya qiladi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral posterior inferior nucleus — a thin cell layer below VPL and VPM.
description.uz: Ventral orqa pastki yadro — VPL va VPM ostidagi yupqa hujayra qatlami.

role.en: Relays vestibular and some spinothalamic input to the parietal operculum and area 3a — sense of head and body position.
role.uz: Vestibulyar va qisman spinotalamik kirishni tepa qopqog'i va 3a maydoniga uzatadi — bosh va tana holati sezgisi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral posterolateral nucleus — the lateral part of the ventral posterior complex, somatotopically ordered (leg lateral, arm medial).
description.uz: Ventral orqa lateral yadro — ventral orqa kompleksning lateral qismi, somatotopik tartibda (oyoq lateral, qo'l medial).

role.en: Receives the medial lemniscus (touch, vibration, proprioception) and spinothalamic tract (pain, temperature) from the body and relays them to the primary somatosensory cortex (areas 3b, 1, 2).
role.uz: Tanadan medial lemniskus (teginish, tebranish, proprioseptsiya) va spinotalamik traktni (og'riq, harorat) qabul qilib, birlamchi somatosensor po'stloqqa (3b, 1, 2 maydonlari) uzatadi.

clinical.en: Lacunar infarct produces pure contralateral hemisensory stroke; later central post-stroke (Dejerine–Roussy) pain. VPL/VPM stimulation has been used for neuropathic pain.
clinical.uz: Lakunar infarkt qarama-qarshi tomonda sof sezgi insultini beradi; keyinchalik markaziy insultdan keyingi (Dejerin–Russi) og'riq. Neyropatik og'riqda VPL/VPM stimulyatsiyasi qo'llanilgan.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral posteromedial nucleus — the crescent-shaped medial part of the ventral posterior complex, next to the centromedian nucleus.
description.uz: Ventral orqa medial yadro — ventral orqa kompleksning o'roqsimon medial qismi, sentromedian yadro yonida.

role.en: Face relay: receives the trigeminal lemniscus and trigeminothalamic tracts and projects to the face area of the postcentral gyrus.
role.uz: Yuz o'tkazgichi: trigeminal lemniskus va trigeminotalamik traktlarni qabul qilib, orqa markaziy pushtaning yuz sohasiga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral facial numbness, typically combined with VPL (cheiro-oral syndrome: hand and mouth).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi yuz uvishishini beradi, ko'pincha VPL bilan birga (heyro-oral sindrom: qo'l va og'iz).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Parvocellular part of VPM — a small-celled medial extension of the ventral posteromedial nucleus.
description.uz: VPM ning parvoselulyar qismi — ventral orqa medial yadroning mayda hujayrali medial davomi.

role.en: Gustatory thalamus: relays taste from the solitary nucleus to the frontal operculum and anterior insula (primary taste cortex).
role.uz: Ta'm talamusi: yakkalangan yadrodan ta'm ma'lumotini peshona qopqog'i va oldingi orolchaga (birlamchi ta'm po'stlog'i) uzatadi.

clinical.en: Lesions can cause contralateral or bilateral taste loss (ageusia) after thalamic stroke.
clinical.uz: Talamik insultdan keyin qarama-qarshi yoki ikki tomonlama ta'm yo'qolishi (agevziya) berishi mumkin.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Zona incerta — a thin sheet of grey matter below the thalamus, between the thalamic fasciculus (H1) and the lenticular fasciculus (H2), continuous laterally with the reticular nucleus.
description.uz: Zona incerta — talamus ostidagi yupqa kulrang modda qatlami; talamik tutam (H1) bilan lentikulyar tutam (H2) orasida, lateralda retikulyar yadroga davom etadi.

role.en: A largely GABAergic integrative hub that gates sensory input, posture and locomotion, and links to arousal and defensive behaviour.
role.uz: Asosan GABAergik integrativ markaz: sezgi kirishi, gavda holati va yurishni 'darvozalaydi', hushyorlik va himoya xulqi bilan bog'langan.

clinical.en: The caudal zona incerta (cZI) and posterior subthalamic area are DBS targets for tremor, often more effective than VIM for proximal tremor.
clinical.uz: Kaudal zona incerta (cZI) va orqa subtalamik soha tremorda DBS nishoni; proksimal tremorda ko'pincha VIM dan samaraliroq.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Lateral geniculate body (corpus geniculatum laterale) — six-layered thalamic nucleus at the end of the optic tract, under the pulvinar.
description.uz: Lateral tizzasimon tana (corpus geniculatum laterale) — ko'rish trakti oxiridagi olti qavatli talamik yadro, pulvinar ostida.

role.en: Visual relay: layers 1–2 magnocellular (motion), 3–6 parvocellular (detail, colour), koniocellular between; projects via the optic radiation to V1 (area hOc1).
role.uz: Ko'rish o'tkazgichi: 1–2 qavatlar magnoselulyar (harakat), 3–6 parvoselulyar (detal, rang), orada konioselulyar; ko'ruv nurlanishi orqali V1 ga (hOc1 maydoni) uzatadi.

clinical.en: Lesions (anterior/posterior choroidal artery territories) give congruous or sectoral homonymous hemianopia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi (oldingi/orqa xorioidal arteriya havzalari) mos yoki sektoral gomonim gemianopiya beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Medial geniculate body (corpus geniculatum mediale) — auditory thalamic nucleus below the pulvinar, receiving the brachium of the inferior colliculus.
description.uz: Medial tizzasimon tana (corpus geniculatum mediale) — pulvinar ostidagi eshituv talamik yadrosi, pastki do'nglik yelkasini qabul qiladi.

role.en: Relays tonotopically ordered sound from the inferior colliculus via the acoustic radiation to Heschl's gyrus (Te 1).
role.uz: Pastki do'nglikdan tonotopik tartiblangan tovushni eshituv nurlanishi orqali Geshl pushtasiga (Te 1) uzatadi.

clinical.en: Being bilateral, unilateral lesions rarely cause deafness; bilateral involvement can cause cortical-type auditory agnosia; implicated in tinnitus.
clinical.uz: Eshituv yo'li ikki tomonlama bo'lgani uchun bir tomonlama zararlanish kamdan-kam karlik beradi; ikki tomonlama zararlanish eshituv agnoziyasiga olib kelishi mumkin; quloq shang'illashida ahamiyati bor.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Subthalamic nucleus (nucleus of Luys) — a lens-shaped nucleus below the zona incerta, above the substantia nigra, medial to the internal capsule.
description.uz: Subtalamik yadro (Lyuis yadrosi) — zona incerta ostida, qora modda ustida, ichki kapsuladan medialda joylashgan linzasimon yadro.

role.en: The only glutamatergic nucleus of the basal ganglia; in the indirect and hyperdirect pathways it excites the internal pallidum to brake movement ('stop' signal).
role.uz: Bazal yadrolarning yagona glutamatergik yadrosi; bilvosita va giperbevosita yo'llarda ichki pallidumni qo'zg'atib, harakatni to'xtatadi ('stop' signali).

clinical.en: The main DBS target in Parkinson's disease (dorsolateral motor part; ~12 mm lateral, 2 mm posterior, 4 mm below the mid-commissural point). Lesion causes contralateral hemiballismus.
clinical.uz: Parkinson kasalligida asosiy DBS nishoni (dorsolateral harakat qismi; o'rta komissural nuqtadan ~12 mm lateral, 2 mm orqa, 4 mm pastda). Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi gemiballizm beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Magnocellular part of the red nucleus — the small caudal portion with giant neurons, in the midbrain tegmentum at the level of the superior colliculus.
description.uz: Qizil yadroning magnoselulyar qismi — yuqori do'nglik sathida o'rta miya tegmentumidagi, gigant neyronli kichik kaudal bo'lak.

role.en: Origin of the rubrospinal tract; in humans rudimentary, as its role in limb control has been taken over by the corticospinal tract.
role.uz: Rubrospinal trakt boshlanishi; odamda rudimentar, chunki qo'l-oyoq nazoratini kortikospinal trakt o'z zimmasiga olgan.

clinical.en: Midbrain lesions through the red nucleus (Benedikt, Claude syndromes) combine oculomotor palsy with contralateral tremor or ataxia.
clinical.uz: Qizil yadro orqali o'tuvchi o'rta miya zararlanishlari (Benedikt, Klod sindromlari) ko'zni harakatlantiruvchi nerv falajini qarama-qarshi tremor yoki ataksiya bilan birga beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Parvocellular part of the red nucleus — the large rostral portion that makes up most of the human red nucleus.
description.uz: Qizil yadroning parvoselulyar qismi — odam qizil yadrosining katta qismini tashkil qiluvchi rostral bo'lak.

role.en: Node of the dentato-rubro-olivary (Guillain–Mollaret) triangle: receives dentate and cortical input and projects via the central tegmental tract to the inferior olive.
role.uz: Dentato-rubro-olivar (Giyen–Mollare) uchburchagining tuguni: tishsimon yadro va po'stloqdan kirish olib, markaziy tegmental trakt orqali pastki zaytunga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Lesions of the triangle cause Holmes (rubral) tremor and palatal myoclonus with hypertrophic olivary degeneration.
clinical.uz: Uchburchak zararlanishi Xolms (rubral) tremori va gipertrofik olivar degeneratsiya bilan tanglay mioklonusini beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Substantia nigra pars compacta — the dorsal, neuromelanin-pigmented layer of dopaminergic neurons in the midbrain.
description.uz: Qora moddaning kompakt qismi — o'rta miyadagi neyromelanin pigmentli dofaminergik neyronlarning dorsal qatlami.

role.en: Supplies dopamine to the dorsal striatum via the nigrostriatal pathway — enabling movement initiation and habit learning.
role.uz: Nigrostriar yo'l orqali dorsal striatumni dofamin bilan ta'minlaydi — harakatni boshlash va odat o'rganishga imkon beradi.

clinical.en: Loss of ~60–80% of its (especially ventrolateral) neurons produces Parkinson's disease; neuromelanin-sensitive MRI and DaT-SPECT image this loss.
clinical.uz: Neyronlarining (ayniqsa ventrolateral) ~60–80% yo'qolishi Parkinson kasalligini keltirib chiqaradi; neyromelanin-sezgir MRT va DaT-SPECT bu yo'qotishni ko'rsatadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Substantia nigra pars reticulata — the ventral, GABAergic part of the substantia nigra, adjoining the cerebral crus.
description.uz: Qora moddaning retikulyar qismi — miya oyoqchasiga tutashgan ventral, GABAergik qismi.

role.en: An output nucleus of the basal ganglia (with the internal pallidum): tonically inhibits the thalamus (VA/VM) and superior colliculus — controls saccades and head/eye orienting.
role.uz: Bazal yadrolarning chiqish yadrosi (ichki pallidum bilan birga): talamus (VA/VM) va yuqori do'nglikni doimiy tormozlaydi — sakkadalar va bosh/ko'z yo'nalishini boshqaradi.

clinical.en: Stimulation spread from STN electrodes into SNr can affect gait and mood; SNr is a candidate target for freezing of gait.
clinical.uz: STN elektrodlaridan SNr ga tarqalgan stimulyatsiya yurish va kayfiyatga ta'sir qilishi mumkin; yurishning 'muzlashi'da nomzod nishon.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Dorsal part of the dentate nucleus — the dorsal (motor) half of the folded, bag-shaped dentate nucleus in the cerebellar white matter.
description.uz: Tishsimon yadroning dorsal qismi — miyacha oq moddasidagi burmalangan, xaltasimon tishsimon yadroning dorsal (harakat) yarmi.

role.en: Receives Purkinje cells of the lateral hemispheres and projects through the superior cerebellar peduncle to the thalamus (VLP/VIM) and motor cortex — planning and timing of skilled movement.
role.uz: Yarim sharlarning lateral qismi Purkinye hujayralaridan kirish olib, yuqori miyacha oyoqchasi orqali talamus (VLP/VIM) va harakat po'stlog'iga uzatadi — mohir harakatni rejalash va vaqtlash.

clinical.en: Lesion gives ipsilateral limb ataxia, dysmetria and intention tremor.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi o'sha tomonda qo'l-oyoq ataksiyasi, dismetriya va intension tremor beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral part of the dentate nucleus — its ventral (non-motor) half.
description.uz: Tishsimon yadroning ventral qismi — uning ventral (harakatdan tashqari) yarmi.

role.en: Projects via the thalamus to prefrontal and posterior parietal cortex — the cerebellar contribution to cognition, language and working memory.
role.uz: Talamus orqali prefrontal va orqa tepa po'stlog'iga uzatadi — miyachaning tafakkur, nutq va ishchi xotiraga qo'shgan hissasi.

clinical.en: Its disruption is linked to the cerebellar cognitive affective (Schmahmann) syndrome.
clinical.uz: Uning buzilishi miyachaning kognitiv-affektiv (Shmaxman) sindromi bilan bog'liq.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Fastigial nucleus — the most medial deep cerebellar nucleus, in the roof of the fourth ventricle beneath the vermis.
description.uz: Chodir yadrosi (nucleus fastigii) — eng medial chuqur miyacha yadrosi; chuvalchang ostida, IV qorincha tomida.

role.en: Receives the vermis and projects via the inferior cerebellar peduncle (uncinate fasciculus) to vestibular and reticular nuclei — balance, posture, gait and saccade accuracy.
role.uz: Chuvalchangdan kirish olib, pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (ilmoqsimon tutam) orqali vestibulyar va retikulyar yadrolarga uzatadi — muvozanat, gavda holati, yurish va sakkada aniqligi.

clinical.en: Midline (vermian) lesions — e.g. medulloblastoma in children — cause truncal ataxia and wide-based gait; fastigial lesions cause saccadic dysmetria.
clinical.uz: O'rta chiziq (chuvalchang) zararlanishi — masalan, bolalarda medulloblastoma — tana ataksiyasi va keng asosli yurish beradi; chodir yadrosi zararlanishi sakkadik dismetriya beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Interposed nucleus — the emboliform and globose nuclei together, between the dentate and fastigial nuclei.
description.uz: Oraliq yadro — tiqinsimon (emboliform) va sharsimon (globoz) yadrolar birgalikda; tishsimon va chodir yadrolari orasida.

role.en: Receives the paravermal (intermediate) zone and projects via the superior cerebellar peduncle to the red nucleus and thalamus — corrects ongoing limb movements using spinal feedback.
role.uz: Paravermal (oraliq) zonadan kirish olib, yuqori miyacha oyoqchasi orqali qizil yadro va talamusga uzatadi — orqa miya qayta aloqasi yordamida davom etayotgan harakatni tuzatadi.

clinical.en: Lesion causes ipsilateral action tremor and limb ataxia.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi o'sha tomonda harakat tremori va qo'l-oyoq ataksiyasini beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Bed nucleus of the stria terminalis — grey matter around the anterior commissure and the end of the stria terminalis, next to the septum and nucleus accumbens.
description.uz: Oxirgi yo'l (stria terminalis) to'shak yadrosi — oldingi komissura va stria terminalis oxiri atrofidagi kulrang modda; septum va accumbens yonida.

role.en: Part of the 'extended amygdala': relays amygdala output to the hypothalamus and brainstem to sustain anxiety and stress responses (unlike the phasic fear of the central amygdala).
role.uz: 'Kengaytirilgan amigdala' qismi: amigdala chiqishini gipotalamus va miya ustuniga uzatib, davomli xavotir va stress javoblarini ushlab turadi (markaziy amigdalaning qisqa qo'rquvidan farqli).

clinical.en: BNST is a DBS target under investigation for refractory obsessive-compulsive disorder and depression; sexually dimorphic in size.
clinical.uz: Refrakter obsessiv-kompulsiv buzilish va depressiyada o'rganilayotgan DBS nishoni; hajmi jinsiy dimorf.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture
Wikipedia — Bed nucleus of the stria terminalis

j-ch-123.uz: Ch1–3 xolinergik guruhlar (septum va Broka diagonal tasmasi)

description.en: Cholinergic cell groups Ch1–Ch3 — the medial septal nucleus (Ch1) and the vertical (Ch2) and horizontal (Ch3) limbs of the diagonal band of Broca.
description.uz: Ch1–Ch3 xolinergik hujayra guruhlari — medial septal yadro (Ch1) hamda Broka diagonal tasmasining vertikal (Ch2) va gorizontal (Ch3) oyoqlari.

role.en: Ch1–2 send acetylcholine to the hippocampus via the fornix (generating theta rhythm); Ch3 innervates the olfactory bulb and piriform/entorhinal cortex.
role.uz: Ch1–2 fornix orqali gippokampga atsetilxolin yuboradi (teta ritmni hosil qiladi); Ch3 hid piyozchasi va noksimon/entorinal po'stloqni innervatsiya qiladi.

clinical.en: Degenerates in Alzheimer's disease; fornix/septal damage (e.g. after colloid cyst or ACoA aneurysm surgery) impairs memory.
clinical.uz: Altsgeymer kasalligida degeneratsiyalanadi; fornix/septum shikastlanishi (masalan, kolloid kista yoki ACoA anevrizmasi jarrohligidan keyin) xotirani buzadi.

sources.title: Zaborszky et al. 2008 — Stereotaxic probabilistic maps of the magnocellular cell groups in human basal forebrain

description.en: Cholinergic group Ch4 — the nucleus basalis of Meynert in the substantia innominata, beneath the globus pallidus and anterior commissure.
description.uz: Ch4 xolinergik guruhi — rangpar shar va oldingi komissura ostidagi substantia innominata ichidagi Meynert bazal yadrosi.

role.en: Main source of acetylcholine for the whole neocortex and amygdala — attention, learning and cortical activation.
role.uz: Butun neokorteks va amigdala uchun atsetilxolinning asosiy manbai — diqqat, o'rganish va po'stloq faollashuvi.

clinical.en: Severe neuronal loss in Alzheimer's disease and Lewy body dementia — the basis of cholinesterase-inhibitor therapy; explored as a DBS target in dementia.
clinical.uz: Altsgeymer va Lyui tanachali demensiyada neyronlari keskin kamayadi — xolinesteraza ingibitorlari davosining asosi; demensiyada DBS nishoni sifatida o'rganilgan.

sources.title: Zaborszky et al. 2008 — Stereotaxic probabilistic maps of the magnocellular cell groups in human basal forebrain

description.en: Olfactory tubercle — a small bulge of the anterior perforated substance behind the olfactory trigone.
description.uz: Hid do'mbog'i — hid uchburchagi ortidagi oldingi teshikli moddaning kichik bo'rtig'i.

role.en: Part of the ventral striatum receiving olfactory input and dense dopamine from the VTA — links smells with reward and motivation.
role.uz: Hid kirishi va VTA dan zich dofamin oluvchi ventral striatum qismi — hidlarni mukofot va motivatsiya bilan bog'laydi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Terminal islands (islands of Calleja) — dense clusters of granule cells in the olfactory tubercle and ventral striatum.
description.uz: Terminal orolchalar (Kalleja orolchalari) — hid do'mbog'i va ventral striatumdagi donador hujayralarning zich to'plamlari.

role.en: Rich in dopamine D3 receptors; thought to modulate reward and grooming behaviour.
role.uz: Dofamin D3 retseptorlariga boy; mukofot va parvarish xulqini modulyatsiya qiladi deb hisoblanadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Lateral part of the nucleus accumbens — roughly the 'core', continuous with the caudate and putamen above.
description.uz: Accumbens yadrosining lateral qismi — taxminan 'o'zak', yuqorida dumli yadro va putamenga davom etadi.

role.en: Translates motivation into action: learning of reward-predicting cues and goal-directed approach behaviour.
role.uz: Motivatsiyani harakatga aylantiradi: mukofotni bashorat qiluvchi signallarni o'rganish va maqsadga yo'nalgan yaqinlashish xulqi.

clinical.en: Target of DBS (ventral capsule/ventral striatum) for obsessive-compulsive disorder and treatment-resistant depression.
clinical.uz: Obsessiv-kompulsiv buzilish va davoga chidamli depressiyada DBS nishoni (ventral kapsula/ventral striatum).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Medial part of the nucleus accumbens — roughly the 'shell', bordering the septum and olfactory tubercle.
description.uz: Accumbens yadrosining medial qismi — taxminan 'qobiq', septum va hid do'mbog'iga tutashgan.

role.en: Hedonic 'liking' and the reinforcing effect of drugs: receives dense VTA dopamine and limbic input from the amygdala and hippocampus.
role.uz: Gedonik 'yoqish' va giyohvand moddalarning mustahkamlovchi ta'siri: VTA dan zich dofamin va amigdala, gippokampdan limbik kirish oladi.

clinical.en: Central to addiction; explored as a DBS target for alcohol and opioid dependence.
clinical.uz: Giyohvandlikda markaziy o'rin tutadi; alkogol va opioid qaramligida DBS nishoni sifatida o'rganilgan.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Fundus of the caudate nucleus — the ventral part of the caudate head where it merges with the nucleus accumbens.
description.uz: Dumli yadro tubi — dumli yadro boshining ventral qismi, accumbens bilan qo'shiladigan joy.

role.en: Transitional ventral striatum linking limbic reward signals with associative (prefrontal) striatal loops.
role.uz: Limbik mukofot signallarini assotsiativ (prefrontal) striar halqalar bilan bog'lovchi o'tuvchi ventral striatum.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Fundus of the putamen — the ventral part of the putamen below the anterior commissure, merging with the ventral striatum.
description.uz: Putamen tubi — oldingi komissura ostidagi putamenning ventral qismi, ventral striatumga qo'shiladi.

role.en: Ventral striatal territory receiving input from the amygdala, orbitofrontal and insular cortex.
role.uz: Amigdala, orbitofrontal va orolcha po'stlog'idan kirish oluvchi ventral striar soha.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Ventral pallidum — pallidal tissue beneath the anterior commissure, within the substantia innominata.
description.uz: Ventral pallidum — oldingi komissura ostidagi, substantia innominata ichidagi pallidum to'qimasi.

role.en: Main output of the nucleus accumbens: projects to the mediodorsal thalamus, VTA and lateral hypothalamus; a 'hedonic hotspot' that turns reward value into motivated behaviour.
role.uz: Accumbensning asosiy chiqishi: mediodorsal talamus, VTA va lateral gipotalamusga uzatadi; mukofot qiymatini motivatsiyalangan xulqqa aylantiruvchi 'gedonik nuqta'.

clinical.en: Lesions can cause anhedonia and loss of motivation (abulia).
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi angedoniya va motivatsiya yo'qolishi (abuliya) berishi mumkin.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Amygdalostriatal transition area — the dorsal-caudal zone where the amygdala blends into the tail of the caudate and the putamen.
description.uz: Amigdala-striatum o'tish sohasi — amigdala dumli yadro dumi va putamen bilan qo'shiladigan dorsal-kaudal zona.

role.en: Mixed striatal and amygdalar cell types; thought to link amygdala-based emotional evaluation with striatal action selection.
role.uz: Striatum va amigdala hujayralari aralash; amigdaladagi emotsional baholashni striatumdagi harakat tanlovi bilan bog'laydi deb hisoblanadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Intermediate fibre bundle of the amygdala (lamella dorsalis of Brockhaus) — a sheet of white matter separating nuclear groups inside the amygdala, delineated in the Julich-Brain atlas.
description.uz: Amigdalaning oraliq tola to'plami (Brokxaus bo'yicha lamella dorsalis) — amigdala ichidagi yadro guruhlarini ajratuvchi oq modda qatlami; Julich-Brain atlasida ajratilgan.

role.en: Carries fibres between amygdala nuclei and toward the stria terminalis.
role.uz: Amigdala yadrolari orasida va stria terminalis tomon tolalarni o'tkazadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Laterobasal nuclear group — the lateral, basolateral, basomedial and paralaminar nuclei, forming the largest part of the human amygdala.
description.uz: Laterobazal yadrolar guruhi — lateral, bazolateral, bazomedial va paralaminar yadrolar; odam amigdalasining eng katta qismi.

role.en: Main input stage: receives highly processed sensory information from the temporal cortex and thalamus and learns which stimuli predict threat or reward; talks back to the prefrontal cortex and hippocampus.
role.uz: Asosiy kirish bosqichi: chakka po'stlog'i va talamusdan yuqori darajada qayta ishlangan sezgi ma'lumotini olib, qaysi stimul xavf yoki mukofotni bashorat qilishini o'rganadi; prefrontal po'stloq va gippokampga javob qaytaradi.

clinical.en: Selective bilateral calcification (Urbach–Wiethe disease) abolishes fear recognition; hyperactive in anxiety disorders and PTSD; frequent seizure onset zone in mesial temporal epilepsy.
clinical.uz: Tanlab ikki tomonlama kalsinatsiyasi (Urbax–Vite kasalligi) qo'rquvni tanishni yo'qotadi; xavotir buzilishlari va TSSB da giperfaol; mezial chakka epilepsiyasida tez-tez tutqanoq boshlanish zonasi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Medial fibre bundle of the amygdala (Brockhaus) — white matter on the medial side of the amygdala, delineated as a separate map in Julich-Brain.
description.uz: Amigdalaning medial tola to'plami (Brokxaus) — amigdala medial tomonidagi oq modda; Julich-Brain'da alohida xarita sifatida ajratilgan.

role.en: Conveys fibres of the centromedial and superficial groups, partly toward the stria terminalis.
role.uz: Sentromedial va yuza guruh tolalarini, qisman stria terminalis tomon o'tkazadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Superficial (cortex-like) group of the amygdala — the cortical nuclei, periamygdaloid cortex and nucleus of the lateral olfactory tract on the medial surface, under the semilunar gyrus.
description.uz: Amigdalaning yuza (po'stloqsimon) guruhi — medial yuzadagi po'stloq yadrolari, periamigdaloid po'stloq va lateral hid trakti yadrosi, yarim oysimon pushta ostida.

role.en: Receives direct olfactory input; involved in social signals and processing of facial expressions.
role.uz: Bevosita hid kirishini oladi; ijtimoiy signallar va yuz ifodalarini qayta ishlashda ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Ventromedial part of the stria terminalis within the amygdala (Brockhaus) — the start of the fibre bundle that leaves the amygdala dorsally.
description.uz: Amigdala ichidagi stria terminalisning ventromedial qismi (Brokxaus) — amigdaladan dorsal chiquvchi tola to'plamining boshlanishi.

role.en: Carries amygdala output (mainly from the centromedial group) around the lateral ventricle to the BNST and hypothalamus.
role.uz: Amigdala chiqishini (asosan sentromedial guruhdan) yon qorincha atrofidan BNST va gipotalamusga olib boradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cornu Ammonis field 1 — the largest hippocampal field, between CA2 and the subiculum.
description.uz: Ammon shoxining 1-maydoni — gippokampning eng katta maydoni, CA2 va subikulum orasida.

role.en: Receives the Schaffer collaterals from CA3 and the temporoammonic path from the entorhinal cortex and sends the main hippocampal output to the subiculum — memory encoding, place cells.
role.uz: CA3 dan Shaffer kollateralarini va entorinal po'stloqdan temporoammonik yo'lni qabul qilib, gippokampning asosiy chiqishini subikulumga yuboradi — xotirani kodlash, joy hujayralari.

clinical.en: The most vulnerable field (Sommer sector): selectively lost in hypoxia–ischaemia, hippocampal sclerosis of mesial temporal epilepsy and early Alzheimer's disease.
clinical.uz: Eng zaif maydon (Zommer sektori): gipoksiya-ishemiyada, mezial chakka epilepsiyasining gippokamp sklerozida va erta Altsgeymer kasalligida tanlab yo'qoladi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Cornu Ammonis field 2 — a narrow strip of densely packed pyramidal cells between CA3 and CA1.
description.uz: Ammon shoxining 2-maydoni — CA3 va CA1 orasidagi zich joylashgan piramidal hujayralarning tor tasmasi.

role.en: Lacks mossy-fibre input; important for social memory and receives hypothalamic (vasopressin) input.
role.uz: Moxsimon tola kirishi yo'q; ijtimoiy xotira uchun muhim va gipotalamusdan (vazopressin) kirish oladi.

clinical.en: Relatively resistant in hippocampal sclerosis (spared in typical ILAE type 1).
clinical.uz: Gippokamp sklerozida nisbatan chidamli (tipik ILAE 1-turida saqlanadi).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Cornu Ammonis field 3 — the curved field whose end (CA4/hilus) enters the dentate gyrus.
description.uz: Ammon shoxining 3-maydoni — oxiri (CA4/hilus) tishsimon pushta ichiga kiradigan egilgan maydon.

role.en: Receives mossy fibres from dentate granule cells; its extensive recurrent collaterals form an auto-associative network for pattern completion (recalling a whole memory from a fragment).
role.uz: Tishsimon pushta donador hujayralaridan moxsimon tolalarni oladi; keng takroriy kollateralari naqshni to'ldirish (xotirani bo'lagidan to'liq eslash) uchun avto-assotsiativ tarmoq hosil qiladi.

clinical.en: Its recurrent network makes it prone to seizure generation; CA3/CA4 cell loss is part of hippocampal sclerosis.
clinical.uz: Takroriy tarmog'i uni tutqanoq hosil qilishga moyil qiladi; CA3/CA4 hujayra yo'qolishi gippokamp sklerozining qismi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Dentate gyrus — the C-shaped band of granule cells capping the end of CA3/CA4, with its hilus.
description.uz: Tishsimon pushta — CA3/CA4 oxirini qalpoq kabi o'raydigan donador hujayralarning C-shaklidagi tasmasi, hilusi bilan.

role.en: Entry of the trisynaptic circuit: receives the perforant path from the entorhinal cortex; separates similar experiences into distinct codes (pattern separation). One of the few sites of adult neurogenesis.
role.uz: Trisinaptik zanjirning kirishi: entorinal po'stloqdan perforant yo'lni oladi; o'xshash tajribalarni alohida kodlarga ajratadi (naqsh ajratish). Kattalarda neyrogenez kuzatiladigan kam joylardan biri.

clinical.en: Granule cell dispersion and mossy fibre sprouting are hallmarks of hippocampal sclerosis in temporal lobe epilepsy.
clinical.uz: Donador hujayralar dispersiyasi va moxsimon tolalar o'sishi chakka epilepsiyasidagi gippokamp sklerozining belgilari.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Hippocampal–amygdaloid transition area — medial grey matter at the junction of the hippocampal head and the amygdala, in the uncus.
description.uz: Gippokamp-amigdala o'tish sohasi — unkusdagi gippokamp boshi va amigdala tutashgan joyidagi medial kulrang modda.

role.en: Anatomical bridge between memory (hippocampus) and emotion (amygdala) systems.
role.uz: Xotira (gippokamp) va emotsiya (amigdala) tizimlari orasidagi anatomik ko'prik.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Subicular complex — subiculum, presubiculum and parasubiculum, between CA1 and the entorhinal cortex on the parahippocampal gyrus.
description.uz: Subikulyar kompleks — subikulum, presubikulum va parasubikulum; CA1 bilan entorinal po'stloq orasida, gippokamp yoni pushtasida.

role.en: Main output of the hippocampus: projects via the fornix to the mammillary bodies and anterior thalamus and back to the entorhinal cortex; contains head-direction and grid-like cells.
role.uz: Gippokampning asosiy chiqishi: fornix orqali so'rg'ichsimon tanalar va oldingi talamusga hamda entorinal po'stloqqa qaytib uzatadi; bosh yo'nalishi va to'rsimon hujayralarni saqlaydi.

clinical.en: Participates in seizure propagation in mesial temporal lobe epilepsy.
clinical.uz: Mezial chakka epilepsiyasida tutqanoqning tarqalishida ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Transsubiculum — the transition zone between the presubiculum and the entorhinal cortex.
description.uz: Transsubikulum — presubikulum bilan entorinal po'stloq orasidagi o'tish zonasi.

role.en: Connects the subicular output with the entorhinal cortex — part of the hippocampal–parahippocampal loop.
role.uz: Subikulyar chiqishni entorinal po'stloq bilan bog'laydi — gippokamp-parahippokampal halqaning qismi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Entorhinal cortex (Brodmann area 28) — the anterior parahippocampal gyrus and uncus, recognisable by the wart-like islands of layer II cells (verrucae hippocampi).
description.uz: Entorinal po'stloq (Brodmann 28-maydoni) — gippokamp yoni pushtasining oldingi qismi va unkus; II qavat hujayralarining so'galsimon orolchalari (verrucae hippocampi) bilan tanilgan.

role.en: Gateway of the hippocampus: funnels multimodal cortical input via the perforant path to the dentate gyrus and receives the hippocampal output; grid cells map space.
role.uz: Gippokamp darvozasi: ko'p modalli po'stloq kirishini perforant yo'l orqali tishsimon pushtaga yo'naltiradi va gippokamp chiqishini qabul qiladi; to'r hujayralari fazoni xaritalaydi.

clinical.en: First cortical region to accumulate neurofibrillary tangles in Alzheimer's disease (Braak stage I–II) — explains early memory loss; thinning is an MRI biomarker.
clinical.uz: Altsgeymer kasalligida neyrofibrillyar chigallar birinchi to'planadigan po'stloq (Braak I–II bosqichi) — erta xotira yo'qolishini tushuntiradi; yupqalashuvi MRT biomarkeri.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2005 — Cytoarchitectonic mapping of the human amygdala, hippocampal region and entorhinal cortex

description.en: Anterior part of the primary motor cortex (BA4), on the crown and upper anterior wall of the precentral gyrus.
description.uz: Birlamchi harakat po'stlog'ining (BA4) oldingi qismi; oldingi markaziy pushta cho'qqisi va oldingi devorining yuqori qismida.

role.en: Agranular cortex with giant Betz cells; issues corticospinal commands in a somatotopic map (homunculus: leg medial, face lateral). 4a differs from 4p in receptor density and is engaged more by simple execution.
role.uz: Gigant Bets hujayralari bo'lgan agranulyar po'stloq; somatotopik xaritada (gomunkulus: oyoq medialda, yuz lateralda) kortikospinal buyruqlar beradi. 4a retseptor zichligi bo'yicha 4p dan farq qiladi va oddiy bajarishda ko'proq faollashadi.

clinical.en: Lesions give contralateral weakness with upper-motor-neuron signs; the hand knob (inverted omega) is a key landmark for mapping and awake surgery.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda yuqori motoneyron belgilari bilan falajlik beradi; 'qo'l tugmasi' (teskari omega) xaritalash va uyg'oq jarrohlikda asosiy mo'ljal.

sources.title: Geyer et al. 1996 — Two different areas within the primary motor cortex of man

description.en: Posterior part of the primary motor cortex, deep in the anterior bank of the central sulcus next to area 3a.
description.uz: Birlamchi harakat po'stlog'ining orqa qismi; markaziy egatning oldingi devorida chuqurda, 3a maydoni yonida.

role.en: More engaged by attention to movement, fine finger control and motor learning than 4a; densest direct corticomotoneuronal projections.
role.uz: 4a ga nisbatan harakatga diqqat, nozik barmoq nazorati va harakat o'rganishda ko'proq faollashadi; bevosita kortikomotoneyronal proyeksiyalar eng zich.

clinical.en: Target zone in intraoperative motor mapping; direct cortical stimulation here evokes contralateral muscle responses at the lowest thresholds.
clinical.uz: Operatsiya vaqtidagi harakat xaritalashida nishon zona; bevosita po'stloq stimulyatsiyasi bu yerda eng past chegarada qarama-qarshi mushak javobini chaqiradi.

sources.title: Geyer et al. 1996 — Two different areas within the primary motor cortex of man

description.en: Posterior subdivision of the dorsal premotor cortex on the superior precentral gyrus, bordering area 4.
description.uz: Dorsal premotor po'stloqning orqa bo'lagi; oldingi markaziy pushtaning yuqori qismida, 4-maydonga tutashgan.

role.en: Dorsal premotor cortex (PMd) selects and prepares reaching movements guided by external cues.
role.uz: Dorsal premotor po'stloq (PMd) tashqi signallar bilan yo'naltirilgan cho'zilish harakatlarini tanlaydi va tayyorlaydi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Intermediate subdivision of the dorsal premotor cortex, anterior to 6d1.
description.uz: Dorsal premotor po'stloqning oraliq bo'lagi, 6d1 ning oldida.

role.en: Links arm-movement planning with visuospatial input from the parietal lobe.
role.uz: Qo'l harakatini rejalashni tepa bo'lagidan keladigan ko'ruv-fazoviy ma'lumot bilan bog'laydi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Most anterior dorsal premotor subdivision, in the posterior superior frontal sulcus next to the frontal eye field.
description.uz: Eng oldingi dorsal premotor bo'lak; yuqori peshona egatining orqa qismida, peshona ko'z maydoni yonida.

role.en: Transition from motor to oculomotor/attentional control; overlaps the region of the human frontal eye field.
role.uz: Harakat nazoratidan okulomotor/diqqat nazoratiga o'tish; odam peshona ko'z maydoni sohasi bilan qisman ustma-ust.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Rostral ventral premotor area on the precentral gyrus near the junction with the inferior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: Oldingi markaziy pushtaning pastki peshona egati bilan tutashgan joyi yaqinidagi rostral ventral premotor maydon.

role.en: Integrates premotor and prefrontal control of hand and eye movements.
role.uz: Qo'l va ko'z harakatlarining premotor va prefrontal nazoratini birlashtiradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Posterior ventral premotor area on the lower precentral gyrus.
description.uz: Oldingi markaziy pushtaning pastki qismidagi orqa ventral premotor maydon.

role.en: Ventral premotor cortex (PMv) controls grasping and orofacial movements; contains mirror-neuron-like responses.
role.uz: Ventral premotor po'stloq (PMv) ushlash va og'iz-yuz harakatlarini boshqaradi; ko'zgu neyronlariga o'xshash javoblar bor.

clinical.en: Its orofacial part participates in speech articulation; lesions may cause dysarthria or apraxia of speech.
clinical.uz: Og'iz-yuz qismi nutq artikulyatsiyasida ishtirok etadi; zararlanishi dizartriya yoki nutq apraksiyasi berishi mumkin.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Intermediate ventral premotor area, anterior to 6v1.
description.uz: Oraliq ventral premotor maydon, 6v1 oldida.

role.en: Hand–mouth motor control and action observation, bordering Broca's region.
role.uz: Qo'l-og'iz harakat nazorati va harakatni kuzatish; Broka sohasiga tutashgan.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Most anterior ventral premotor area, adjoining area 44 of the inferior frontal gyrus.
description.uz: Eng oldingi ventral premotor maydon, pastki peshona pushtasining 44-maydoniga tutashgan.

role.en: Articulatory planning and sequencing, forming the premotor border of Broca's region.
role.uz: Artikulyatsiyani rejalash va ketma-ketlashtirish; Broka sohasining premotor chegarasi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area 3a — the fundus of the central sulcus between area 4 and area 3b.
description.uz: 3a maydoni — markaziy egat tubi, 4-maydon bilan 3b orasida.

role.en: Receives muscle-spindle and joint (proprioceptive) and vestibular input; closely linked to motor cortex for sensorimotor control.
role.uz: Mushak urchuqlari va bo'g'imlardan (proprioseptiv) hamda vestibulyar kirish oladi; sensomotor nazorat uchun harakat po'stlog'i bilan chambarchas bog'langan.

sources.title: Geyer et al. 1999 — Areas 3a, 3b and 1 of human primary somatosensory cortex

description.en: Area 3b — the posterior bank of the central sulcus; the core primary somatosensory cortex (koniocortex).
description.uz: 3b maydoni — markaziy egatning orqa devori; birlamchi somatosensor po'stloqning asosi (koniokorteks).

role.en: Main target of VPL/VPM: fine touch, pressure and vibration in a detailed somatotopic map (sensory homunculus).
role.uz: VPL/VPM ning asosiy nishoni: nozik teginish, bosim va tebranish batafsil somatotopik xaritada (sezgi gomunkulusi).

clinical.en: Lesions cause contralateral loss of discriminative touch (astereognosis, impaired two-point discrimination); stimulation-evoked paraesthesias confirm the central sulcus during surgery.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi qarama-qarshi tomonda farqlovchi sezgining yo'qolishi (astereognoz, ikki nuqtani farqlash buzilishi) beradi; jarrohlikda stimulyatsiya paresteziyalari markaziy egatni tasdiqlaydi.

sources.title: Geyer et al. 1999 — Areas 3a, 3b and 1 of human primary somatosensory cortex

description.en: Area 1 — the crown of the postcentral gyrus.
description.uz: 1-maydon — orqa markaziy pushta cho'qqisi.

role.en: Processes texture from cutaneous input relayed by area 3b.
role.uz: 3b maydonidan kelgan teri kirishidan teksturani qayta ishlaydi.

sources.title: Geyer et al. 1999 — Areas 3a, 3b and 1 of human primary somatosensory cortex

description.en: Area 2 — the posterior slope of the postcentral gyrus and anterior wall of the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: 2-maydon — orqa markaziy pushtaning orqa qiyaligi va orqa markaziy egatning oldingi devori.

role.en: Combines touch and proprioception into size and shape of grasped objects; relays to the superior parietal lobule.
role.uz: Teginish va proprioseptsiyani birlashtirib, ushlangan buyumning o'lchami va shaklini aniqlaydi; yuqori tepa bo'lakchasiga uzatadi.

sources.title: Grefkes et al. 2001 — Human somatosensory area 2

description.en: Posterior mesial area 6 — the supplementary motor area (SMA proper) on the medial superior frontal gyrus in front of the paracentral lobule.
description.uz: Medial 6-maydonning orqa qismi — parasentral bo'lakcha oldida, yuqori peshona pushtasining medial yuzasidagi qo'shimcha harakat sohasi (SMA proper).

role.en: Internally generated and sequential movements, bimanual coordination and postural preparation; somatotopic.
role.uz: Ichki boshlangan va ketma-ket harakatlar, ikki qo'l muvofiqligi va gavdaning tayyorgarligi; somatotopik.

clinical.en: Resection causes the transient SMA syndrome (contralateral akinesia and mutism that recover within weeks) — important in counselling for parafalcine glioma surgery.
clinical.uz: Rezeksiyasi vaqtinchalik SMA sindromini (bir necha haftada tiklanadigan qarama-qarshi akineziya va mutizm) beradi — falks yoni gliomasi jarrohligida bemorga tushuntirish uchun muhim.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Anterior mesial area 6 — the pre-supplementary motor area, in front of the vertical line through the anterior commissure (VCA line).
description.uz: Medial 6-maydonning oldingi qismi — qo'shimcha harakat sohasi oldi (pre-SMA); oldingi komissura orqali o'tgan vertikal chiziq (VCA) oldida.

role.en: Higher-order motor control: learning new sequences, switching and inhibiting responses, and voluntary action selection.
role.uz: Yuqori darajadagi harakat nazorati: yangi ketma-ketliklarni o'rganish, javobni almashtirish va tormozlash, ixtiyoriy harakat tanlash.

clinical.en: Left pre-SMA damage can impair speech initiation; implicated in tic disorders.
clinical.uz: Chap pre-SMA zararlanishi nutqni boshlashni buzishi mumkin; tik buzilishlarida ahamiyati bor.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Posterior dorsal area 8 on the superior frontal gyrus.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona pushtasidagi orqa dorsal 8-maydon.

role.en: Oculomotor and attentional control — part of the frontal eye field region and dorsal attention network.
role.uz: Okulomotor va diqqat nazorati — peshona ko'z maydoni sohasi va dorsal diqqat tarmog'ining qismi.

clinical.en: Frontal eye field lesions cause transient gaze deviation toward the lesion side.
clinical.uz: Peshona ko'z maydoni zararlanishi nigohning zararlangan tomonga vaqtincha og'ishini beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Anterior dorsal area 8, in front of 8d1 on the superior frontal gyrus.
description.uz: Oldingi dorsal 8-maydon, yuqori peshona pushtasida 8d1 oldida.

role.en: Prefrontal control of attention and working memory at the transition to area 9.
role.uz: 9-maydonga o'tishda diqqat va ishchi xotiraning prefrontal nazorati.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Posterior ventral area 8 on the middle frontal gyrus.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasidagi orqa ventral 8-maydon.

role.en: Saccade planning and top-down visual attention.
role.uz: Sakkadani rejalash va yuqoridan pastga ko'ruv diqqati.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Anterior ventral area 8 on the middle frontal gyrus.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasidagi oldingi ventral 8-maydon.

role.en: Cognitive control of attention and rule-guided behaviour.
role.uz: Diqqatning kognitiv nazorati va qoidaga asoslangan xulq.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 2 of the superior frontal gyrus (Julich-Brain), in the dorsal prefrontal cortex.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona pushtasining 2-sitoarxitektonik maydoni (Julich-Brain), dorsal prefrontal po'stloqda.

role.en: Dorsal prefrontal functions: working memory, self-referential thinking and action monitoring.
role.uz: Dorsal prefrontal vazifalar: ishchi xotira, o'ziga yo'naltirilgan fikrlash va harakatni kuzatish.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 3 of the superior frontal gyrus, anterior to SFG2.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona pushtasining 3-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, SFG2 oldida.

role.en: Part of the dorsolateral prefrontal network for executive control.
role.uz: Ijroiy nazorat uchun dorsolateral prefrontal tarmoqning qismi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 4 of the superior frontal gyrus, the most anterior, approaching the frontal pole.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona pushtasining 4-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, eng oldingisi, peshona qutbiga yaqinlashadi.

role.en: Higher-order prefrontal processing; part of the default-mode network on the medial surface.
role.uz: Yuqori tartibli prefrontal jarayonlar; medial yuzada standart rejim (default-mode) tarmog'ining qismi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Posterior cytoarchitectonic area of the superior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona egatining orqa sitoarxitektonik maydoni.

role.en: Spatial working memory and attention, near the frontal eye field.
role.uz: Fazoviy ishchi xotira va diqqat, peshona ko'z maydoni yaqinida.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Anterior cytoarchitectonic area of the superior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: Yuqori peshona egatining oldingi sitoarxitektonik maydoni.

role.en: Maintenance and manipulation of information in working memory.
role.uz: Ishchi xotirada ma'lumotni saqlash va boshqarish.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 1 of the middle frontal gyrus (Julich-Brain), in the posterior dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasining 1-sitoarxitektonik maydoni (Julich-Brain), orqa dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloqda.

role.en: Dorsolateral prefrontal cortex: working memory, planning and cognitive flexibility.
role.uz: Dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloq: ishchi xotira, rejalash va kognitiv moslashuvchanlik.

clinical.en: The left DLPFC is the standard rTMS target for treatment-resistant depression.
clinical.uz: Chap DLPFC davoga chidamli depressiyada rTMS ning standart nishoni.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 2 of the middle frontal gyrus.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasining 2-sitoarxitektonik maydoni.

role.en: Executive control and working memory within the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex.
role.uz: Dorsolateral prefrontal po'stloq doirasida ijroiy nazorat va ishchi xotira.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 4 of the middle frontal gyrus, in its anterior part.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasining 4-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, oldingi qismida.

role.en: Abstract rule use and multi-step planning.
role.uz: Abstrakt qoidalardan foydalanish va ko'p bosqichli rejalash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 5 of the middle frontal gyrus, extending onto the inferior frontal gyrus.
description.uz: O'rta peshona pushtasining 5-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, pastki peshona pushtasiga o'tadi.

role.en: Ventrolateral–dorsolateral prefrontal transition: selection and retrieval in working memory and language.
role.uz: Ventrolateral-dorsolateral prefrontal o'tish: ishchi xotira va nutqda tanlash va eslash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 1 of the inferior frontal sulcus (Julich-Brain).
description.uz: Pastki peshona egatining 1-sitoarxitektonik maydoni (Julich-Brain).

role.en: Language-related prefrontal cortex adjoining Broca's region; verbal working memory.
role.uz: Broka sohasiga tutashgan nutq bilan bog'liq prefrontal po'stloq; og'zaki ishchi xotira.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 2 of the inferior frontal sulcus.
description.uz: Pastki peshona egatining 2-sitoarxitektonik maydoni.

role.en: Cognitive control of language and working memory.
role.uz: Nutq va ishchi xotiraning kognitiv nazorati.

description.uz: Pastki peshona egatining 3-sitoarxitektonik maydoni.

role.en: Part of the fronto-parietal control network.
role.uz: Fronto-parietal nazorat tarmog'ining qismi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Cytoarchitectonic area 4 of the inferior frontal sulcus, the most anterior.
description.uz: Pastki peshona egatining 4-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, eng oldingisi.

role.en: Higher-order prefrontal control of semantic processing.
role.uz: Semantik jarayonlarning yuqori darajadagi prefrontal nazorati.

description.uz: Pastki peshona tutashuvi 1-maydoni — pastki peshona egati oldingi markaziy egat bilan uchrashadigan joy.

role.en: Task switching, cognitive control and attention to visual features (colour, shape).
role.uz: Vazifalarni almashtirish, kognitiv nazorat va ko'ruv belgilariga (rang, shakl) diqqat.

description.en: Inferior frontal junction area 2, adjacent to IFJ1.
description.uz: Pastki peshona tutashuvi 2-maydoni, IFJ1 yonida.

role.en: Updating task rules and linking premotor with prefrontal control.
role.uz: Vazifa qoidalarini yangilash va premotor bilan prefrontal nazoratni bog'lash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area 44 — the pars opercularis of the inferior frontal gyrus; dysgranular cortex forming the posterior part of Broca's region.
description.uz: 44-maydon — pastki peshona pushtasining qopqoq qismi (pars opercularis); Broka sohasining orqa qismini tashkil etuvchi disgranulyar po'stloq.

role.en: Speech production, syntax and phonological processing; left-dominant in most right-handers and larger on the left.
role.uz: Nutq hosil qilish, sintaksis va fonologik jarayonlar; ko'pchilik o'naqaylarda chapda dominant va chapda kattaroq.

clinical.en: Lesion of the left area 44/45 region gives non-fluent (Broca's) aphasia; mapped with direct stimulation (speech arrest) in awake craniotomy.
clinical.uz: Chap 44/45 sohasi zararlanishi ravon bo'lmagan (Broka) afaziyasini beradi; uyg'oq kraniotomiyada bevosita stimulyatsiya bilan xaritalanadi (nutq to'xtashi).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 1999 — Broca's region revisited

description.en: Area 45 — the pars triangularis of the inferior frontal gyrus; granular cortex forming the anterior part of Broca's region.
description.uz: 45-maydon — pastki peshona pushtasining uchburchak qismi (pars triangularis); Broka sohasining oldingi qismini tashkil etuvchi granulyar po'stloq.

role.en: Semantic selection and retrieval, verbal fluency and understanding complex sentences.
role.uz: Semantik tanlash va eslash, og'zaki ravonlik va murakkab gaplarni tushunish.

clinical.en: Part of the classic Broca's area; awake mapping protects it during resection of left frontal gliomas.
clinical.uz: Klassik Broka sohasining qismi; chap peshona gliomalari rezeksiyasida uyg'oq xaritalash uni himoya qiladi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 1999 — Broca's region revisited

description.en: Area Op5 — one of six cytoarchitectonic areas (Op5–Op10) of the frontal operculum mapped by the Julich-Brain group, in the posterior frontal operculum, next to the ventral precentral gyrus.
description.uz: Op5 maydoni — Julich-Brain guruhi xaritalagan peshona qopqog'ining olti sitoarxitektonik maydonidan biri (Op5–Op10); orqa peshona qopqog'ida, ventral oldingi markaziy pushta yonida.

role.en: The frontal operculum covers the anterior insula and takes part in taste, orofacial motor control, speech and interoceptive/cognitive control networks.
role.uz: Peshona qopqog'i oldingi orolchani yopib turadi va ta'm, og'iz-yuz harakat nazorati, nutq hamda interoseptiv/kognitiv nazorat tarmoqlarida ishtirok etadi.

clinical.en: Opercular lesions may cause dysarthria, dysphagia or taste disturbance; bilateral damage gives the anterior opercular (Foix–Chavany–Marie) syndrome.
clinical.uz: Qopqoq zararlanishi dizartriya, disfagiya yoki ta'm buzilishini berishi mumkin; ikki tomonlama zararlanish oldingi operkulyar (Fua–Shavani–Mari) sindromini beradi.

description.uz: Op9 maydoni — Julich-Brain guruhi xaritalagan peshona qopqog'ining olti sitoarxitektonik maydonidan biri (Op5–Op10); oldingi peshona qopqog'ida, aylana egat yaqinida.
