description.en: Area Fo1 — medial orbitofrontal area on the gyrus rectus.
description.uz: Fo1 maydoni — to'g'ri pushtadagi medial orbitofrontal maydon.

role.en: Medial OFC encodes reward value and guides value-based choices; part of the default-mode network.
role.uz: Medial OFK mukofot qiymatini kodlaydi va qiymatga asoslangan tanlovni yo'naltiradi; standart rejim tarmog'ining qismi.

clinical.en: Damaged in anterior communicating artery aneurysm rupture, frontal contusions and olfactory-groove meningioma — personality change and disinhibition.
clinical.uz: Oldingi biriktiruvchi arteriya anevrizmasi yorilishi, peshona kontuziyalari va hid chuquri meningiomasida zararlanadi — shaxsiyat o'zgarishi va tormozsizlik.

sources.title: Henssen et al. 2016 — Cytoarchitecture and probability maps of the human medial orbitofrontal cortex

description.en: Area Fo2 — medial orbitofrontal area in the medial orbital sulcus, lateral to Fo1.
description.uz: Fo2 maydoni — Fo1 dan lateralda, medial orbital egatdagi medial orbitofrontal maydon.

role.en: Reward valuation and integration of smell and taste with value.
role.uz: Mukofotni baholash va hid hamda ta'mni qiymat bilan birlashtirish.

sources.title: Henssen et al. 2016 — Cytoarchitecture and probability maps of the human medial orbitofrontal cortex

description.en: Area Fo3 — orbitofrontal area on the medial orbital gyrus.
description.uz: Fo3 maydoni — medial orbital pushtadagi orbitofrontal maydon.

role.en: Links reward representations with memory and autonomic responses.
role.uz: Mukofot tasavvurlarini xotira va vegetativ javoblar bilan bog'laydi.

sources.title: Henssen et al. 2016 — Cytoarchitecture and probability maps of the human medial orbitofrontal cortex

description.en: Area Fo4 — lateral orbitofrontal area on the lateral orbital gyrus.
description.uz: Fo4 maydoni — lateral orbitofrontal maydon, lateral orbital pushtada.

role.en: Lateral OFC evaluates punishments and changing outcomes, supporting reversal learning and inhibition of inappropriate responses.
role.uz: Lateral OFK jazo va o'zgaruvchan natijalarni baholaydi — teskari o'rganish va nomaqbul javoblarni tormozlashni ta'minlaydi.

clinical.en: Implicated in obsessive-compulsive disorder and addiction; lesions produce impulsive, socially inappropriate behaviour.
clinical.uz: Obsessiv-kompulsiv buzilish va giyohvandlikda ahamiyati bor; zararlanishi impulsiv, ijtimoiy nomaqbul xulq beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.uz: Fo5 maydoni — lateral orbitofrontal maydon, oldingi orbital pushtada.

role.en: Lateral OFC evaluates punishments and changing outcomes, supporting reversal learning and inhibition of inappropriate responses.
role.uz: Lateral OFK jazo va o'zgaruvchan natijalarni baholaydi — teskari o'rganish va nomaqbul javoblarni tormozlashni ta'minlaydi.

description.uz: Fo6 maydoni — lateral orbitofrontal maydon, lateral orbital egat atrofida.

role.en: Lateral OFC evaluates punishments and changing outcomes, supporting reversal learning and inhibition of inappropriate responses.
role.uz: Lateral OFK jazo va o'zgaruvchan natijalarni baholaydi — teskari o'rganish va nomaqbul javoblarni tormozlashni ta'minlaydi.

description.uz: Fo7 maydoni — lateral orbitofrontal maydon, orqa-lateral orbital yuzada, orolcha tomon.

role.en: Lateral OFC evaluates punishments and changing outcomes, supporting reversal learning and inhibition of inappropriate responses.
role.uz: Lateral OFK jazo va o'zgaruvchan natijalarni baholaydi — teskari o'rganish va nomaqbul javoblarni tormozlashni ta'minlaydi.

description.en: Area Fp1 — lateral frontal pole (lateral BA10).
description.uz: Fp1 maydoni — lateral peshona qutbi (lateral BA10).

role.en: Metacognition, relational reasoning and managing several goals at once (cognitive branching).
role.uz: Metakognitsiya, munosabatlar bo'yicha fikrlash va bir vaqtda bir necha maqsadni boshqarish (kognitiv tarmoqlanish).

sources.title: Bludau et al. 2014 — Cytoarchitecture of the human frontal pole

description.en: Area Fp2 — medial frontal pole (medial BA10).
description.uz: Fp2 maydoni — medial peshona qutbi (medial BA10).

role.en: Self-referential and social cognition; a hub of the default-mode network.
role.uz: O'ziga yo'naltirilgan va ijtimoiy tafakkur; standart rejim tarmog'ining markazi.

sources.title: Bludau et al. 2014 — Cytoarchitecture of the human frontal pole

description.en: Area 33 — a thin strip of cortex in the callosal sulcus, lining the corpus callosum under the anterior cingulate gyrus.
description.uz: 33-maydon — oldingi belbog' pushtasi ostida, qadoqsimon tanani qoplovchi, qadoqsimon egatdagi yupqa po'stloq tasmasi.

role.en: Pain and emotional awareness; closely related to the adjacent area 24.
role.uz: Og'riq va emotsional anglash; qo'shni 24-maydon bilan yaqin bog'liq.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Pregenual areas 24a/b — anterior cingulate gyrus in front of the genu of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Tizza oldi 24a/b maydonlari — qadoqsimon tana tizzasi oldidagi oldingi belbog' pushtasi.

role.en: Emotion regulation, autonomic control and evaluation of positive and negative feelings.
role.uz: Emotsiyani boshqarish, vegetativ nazorat va ijobiy/salbiy his-tuyg'ularni baholash.

clinical.en: Hub of the affective network; altered in depression and chronic pain.
clinical.uz: Affektiv tarmoq markazi; depressiya va surunkali og'riqda o'zgaradi.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Pregenual area 24c — the part of the pregenual anterior cingulate lying in the cingulate sulcus.
description.uz: Tizza oldi 24c maydoni — tizza oldi oldingi belbog' po'stlog'ining belbog' egatidagi qismi.

role.en: Links emotion with motor output and conflict monitoring.
role.uz: Emotsiyani harakat chiqishi va ziddiyatni kuzatish bilan bog'laydi.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Pregenual area 32 — the paracingulate cortex above and in front of pregenual area 24.
description.uz: Tizza oldi 32-maydoni — tizza oldi 24-maydoni ustida va oldida joylashgan parasingulyar po'stloq.

role.en: Integrates emotion with cognition; involved in mentalizing (theory of mind).
role.uz: Emotsiyani tafakkur bilan birlashtiradi; boshqalarning fikrini tushunishda (theory of mind) ishtirok etadi.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Area 25 — the subgenual cingulate cortex below the genu and rostrum of the corpus callosum, in front of the lamina terminalis.
description.uz: 25-maydon — qadoqsimon tana tizzasi va tumshug'i ostidagi, oxirgi plastinka oldidagi tizza osti belbog' po'stlog'i.

role.en: Controls autonomic and neuroendocrine responses to emotion (heart rate, cortisol); links with the hypothalamus, amygdala and brainstem.
role.uz: Emotsiyaga vegetativ va neyroendokrin javoblarni (yurak urishi, kortizol) boshqaradi; gipotalamus, amigdala va miya ustuni bilan bog'langan.

clinical.en: Hyperactive in major depression; subgenual cingulate white matter (Cg25) is a DBS target for treatment-resistant depression (Mayberg).
clinical.uz: Katta depressiyada giperfaol; tizza osti belbog' oq moddasi (Cg25) davoga chidamli depressiyada DBS nishoni (Meyberg).

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Subgenual area 24 — the part of area 24 below the genu of the corpus callosum.
description.uz: Tizza osti 24-maydoni — 24-maydonning qadoqsimon tana tizzasi ostidagi qismi.

role.en: Mood and autonomic regulation together with area 25.
role.uz: 25-maydon bilan birga kayfiyat va vegetativ boshqaruv.

clinical.en: Part of the subgenual cingulate DBS target region for depression.
clinical.uz: Depressiyada tizza osti belbog' DBS nishon sohasining qismi.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Subgenual area 32 — paracingulate cortex below and in front of the genu.
description.uz: Tizza osti 32-maydoni — tizza ostida va oldida joylashgan parasingulyar po'stloq.

role.en: Emotional appraisal and fear extinction; interacts with the amygdala.
role.uz: Emotsional baholash va qo'rquvning so'nishi; amigdala bilan o'zaro ta'sirda.

sources.title: Palomero-Gallagher et al. 2008 — Cytology and receptor architecture of human anterior cingulate cortex

description.en: Area 5Ci — the part of area 5 in the marginal ramus of the cingulate sulcus, behind the paracentral lobule.
description.uz: 5Ci maydoni — 5-maydonning parasentral bo'lakcha ortidagi, belbog' egatining chekka shoxidagi qismi.

role.en: Somatosensory association of the leg and trunk; links touch and proprioception with posture and locomotion.
role.uz: Oyoq va tananing somatosensor assotsiatsiyasi; teginish va proprioseptsiyani gavda holati va yurish bilan bog'laydi.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Area 5L — lateral area 5 on the anterior superior parietal lobule behind the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: 5L maydoni — orqa markaziy egat ortidagi yuqori tepa bo'lakchasining oldingi qismidagi lateral 5-maydon.

role.en: Builds a body schema of limb position from area 2 input; guides reaching.
role.uz: 2-maydon kirishidan qo'l-oyoq holatining tana sxemasini quradi; cho'zilish harakatini yo'naltiradi.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Area 5M — medial area 5 on the posterior paracentral lobule.
description.uz: 5M maydoni — parasentral bo'lakchaning orqa qismidagi medial 5-maydon.

role.en: Somatosensory association for the lower limb and trunk.
role.uz: Oyoq va tana uchun somatosensor assotsiatsiya.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Area 7A — anterior area 7 on the superior parietal lobule.
description.uz: 7A maydoni — yuqori tepa bo'lakchasidagi oldingi 7-maydon.

role.en: Visuomotor integration: combines vision with limb position to guide reaching and grasping.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-harakat integratsiyasi: qo'l harakatini yo'naltirish uchun ko'rishni qo'l-oyoq holati bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Superior parietal lesions cause optic ataxia (misreaching under visual guidance), part of Bálint syndrome when bilateral.
clinical.uz: Yuqori tepa zararlanishi optik ataksiya (ko'rib turib noto'g'ri cho'zilish) beradi; ikki tomonlama bo'lsa Balint sindromining qismi.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Area 7M — medial area 7 on the precuneus.
description.uz: 7M maydoni — precuneusdagi medial 7-maydon.

role.en: Visuospatial imagery, self-related processing and episodic memory retrieval; part of the default-mode network.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy tasavvur, o'ziga oid jarayonlar va epizodik xotirani eslash; standart rejim tarmog'ining qismi.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Area 7P — posterior area 7 on the superior parietal lobule near the parieto-occipital sulcus.
description.uz: 7P maydoni — tepa-ensa egati yaqinidagi yuqori tepa bo'lakchasining orqa 7-maydoni.

role.en: Visuospatial processing and the visual guidance of eye and hand movements.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy ishlov va ko'z hamda qo'l harakatlarini ko'rish orqali yo'naltirish.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Area 7PC — the most anterior part of area 7, next to the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: 7PC maydoni — 7-maydonning orqa markaziy egat yonidagi eng oldingi qismi.

role.en: Transition between somatosensory area 2 and visuomotor area 7; sensorimotor integration of the hand.
role.uz: Somatosensor 2-maydon bilan ko'ruv-harakat 7-maydoni orasidagi o'tish; qo'lning sensomotor integratsiyasi.

sources.title: Scheperjans et al. 2008 — Human superior parietal cortex

description.en: Area hIP1 — cytoarchitectonic area 1 of the human intraparietal sulcus, on the anterior medial wall of the IPS.
description.uz: hIP1 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 1-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, tepa ichi egatining oldingi medial devorida.

role.en: Number processing and attention; with hIP2 forms the human homologue of monkey area AIP–VIP transition.
role.uz: Sonlarni qayta ishlash va diqqat; hIP2 bilan birga maymunning AIP–VIP o'tish sohasining odamdagi gomologi.

clinical.en: Left anterior IPS damage causes acalculia; right IPS is part of the attention network disrupted in hemispatial neglect.
clinical.uz: Chap oldingi tepa ichi egati zararlanishi akalkuliya beradi; o'ng tepa ichi egati yarim fazoviy e'tiborsizlikda buziladigan diqqat tarmog'ining qismi.

sources.title: Choi et al. 2006 — Cytoarchitectonic areas in the human intraparietal sulcus

description.en: Area hIP2 — cytoarchitectonic area 2 of the human intraparietal sulcus, on the anterior lateral wall of the IPS.
description.uz: hIP2 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 2-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, tepa ichi egatining oldingi lateral devorida.

role.en: Visually guided grasping — the human anterior intraparietal area (AIP) for shaping the hand to objects.
role.uz: Ko'ruv bilan yo'naltirilgan ushlash — qo'lni buyumga moslashtiruvchi odamning oldingi tepa ichi sohasi (AIP).

clinical.en: Left anterior IPS damage causes acalculia; right IPS is part of the attention network disrupted in hemispatial neglect.
clinical.uz: Chap oldingi tepa ichi egati zararlanishi akalkuliya beradi; o'ng tepa ichi egati yarim fazoviy e'tiborsizlikda buziladigan diqqat tarmog'ining qismi.

sources.title: Choi et al. 2006 — Cytoarchitectonic areas in the human intraparietal sulcus

description.en: Area hIP3 — cytoarchitectonic area 3 of the human intraparietal sulcus, on the medial wall of the IPS behind hIP1.
description.uz: hIP3 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 3-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, hIP1 ortida, tepa ichi egatining medial devorida.

role.en: Visuospatial attention and eye-movement related processing (human VIP/LIP region).
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy diqqat va ko'z harakati bilan bog'liq jarayonlar (odamdagi VIP/LIP sohasi).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hIP4 — cytoarchitectonic area 4 of the human intraparietal sulcus, on the posterior IPS near the transverse occipital sulcus.
description.uz: hIP4 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 4-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, orqa tepa ichi egatida, ko'ndalang ensa egati yaqinida.

role.uz: Tepa-ensa o'tishida ko'ruv ishlovi va sakkadani rejalash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.uz: hIP5 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 5-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, orqa tepa ichi egatida, hIP4 dan lateralda.

role.en: Visual attention and spatial maps for eye movements.
role.uz: Ko'ruv diqqati va ko'z harakatlari uchun fazoviy xaritalar.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hIP6 — cytoarchitectonic area 6 of the human intraparietal sulcus, on the middle IPS.
description.uz: hIP6 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 6-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, tepa ichi egatining o'rta qismida.

role.en: Spatial working memory and attention.
role.uz: Fazoviy ishchi xotira va diqqat.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hIP7 — cytoarchitectonic area 7 of the human intraparietal sulcus, on the posterior IPS near hIP4.
description.uz: hIP7 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 7-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, orqa tepa ichi egatida, hIP4 yaqinida.

role.en: Topographic visual maps (IPS0–IPS2 region) for attention.
role.uz: Diqqat uchun topografik ko'ruv xaritalari (IPS0–IPS2 sohasi).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hIP8 — cytoarchitectonic area 8 of the human intraparietal sulcus, on the posterior IPS extending toward the superior parietal lobule.
description.uz: hIP8 maydoni — odam tepa ichi egatining 8-sitoarxitektonik maydoni, orqa tepa ichi egatida, yuqori tepa bo'lakchasi tomon.

role.en: Visuospatial and visuomotor integration.
role.uz: Ko'ruv-fazoviy va ko'ruv-harakat integratsiyasi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area PFop — the most anterior-ventral area of the supramarginal gyrus, next to the parietal operculum.
description.uz: PFop maydoni — supramarginal pushtaning tepa qopqog'i yonidagi eng oldingi-ventral maydoni.

role.en: Somatosensory integration of hand actions and tool use.
role.uz: Qo'l harakatlari va asbobdan foydalanishning somatosensor integratsiyasi.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Area PFt — anterior supramarginal gyrus, behind the postcentral sulcus.
description.uz: PFt maydoni — orqa markaziy egat ortidagi oldingi supramarginal pushta.

role.en: Planning of skilled and tool-use actions (praxis); part of the action-observation network.
role.uz: Mohir va asbob bilan bajariladigan harakatlarni rejalash (praksis); harakatni kuzatish tarmog'ining qismi.

clinical.en: Left inferior parietal lesions cause ideomotor apraxia.
clinical.uz: Chap pastki tepa zararlanishi ideomotor apraksiya beradi.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Area PF — the central supramarginal gyrus.
description.uz: PF maydoni — supramarginal pushtaning markaziy qismi.

role.en: Phonological working memory (left) and body awareness; integrates somatosensory with visual information.
role.uz: Fonologik ishchi xotira (chapda) va tanani anglash; somatosensor ma'lumotni ko'ruv ma'lumoti bilan birlashtiradi.

clinical.en: Left supramarginal lesions (with the arcuate fasciculus) produce conduction aphasia — impaired repetition.
clinical.uz: Chap supramarginal zararlanish (yoysimon tutam bilan) o'tkazuvchanlik afaziyasini beradi — takrorlash buziladi.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Area PFcm — the caudal-medial supramarginal gyrus, reaching into the posterior Sylvian fissure above the parietal operculum.
description.uz: PFcm maydoni — supramarginal pushtaning kaudal-medial qismi, tepa qopqog'i ustida orqa Silviy yorig'iga kiradi.

role.en: Auditory–somatosensory integration; part of the ventral language and vestibular networks.
role.uz: Eshituv-somatosensor integratsiya; ventral nutq va vestibulyar tarmoqlarning qismi.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Area PFm — the posterior supramarginal gyrus at the transition to the angular gyrus.
description.uz: PFm maydoni — supramarginal pushtaning burchak pushtasiga o'tish joyidagi orqa qismi.

role.en: Attention reorienting and social cognition; a hub of the temporoparietal junction.
role.uz: Diqqatni qayta yo'naltirish va ijtimoiy tafakkur; temporo-parietal tutashuv markazi.

clinical.en: Right-sided temporoparietal lesions cause hemispatial neglect.
clinical.uz: O'ng temporo-parietal zararlanish yarim fazoviy e'tiborsizlik beradi.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Area PGa — anterior angular gyrus.
description.uz: PGa maydoni — burchak pushtasining oldingi qismi.

role.en: Semantic processing, reading and number facts; default-mode network node.
role.uz: Semantik ishlov, o'qish va son faktlari; standart rejim tarmog'i tuguni.

clinical.en: Left angular gyrus lesions give Gerstmann syndrome (acalculia, agraphia, finger agnosia, left–right confusion) and alexia with agraphia.
clinical.uz: Chap burchak pushtasi zararlanishi Gerstman sindromi (akalkuliya, agrafiya, barmoq agnoziyasi, o'ng-chapni adashtirish) va agrafiya bilan aleksiya beradi.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Area PGp — posterior angular gyrus, bordering the occipital lobe.
description.uz: PGp maydoni — burchak pushtasining ensa bo'lagiga tutashgan orqa qismi.

role.en: Links higher visual areas with semantic memory; episodic retrieval and spatial orientation.
role.uz: Yuqori ko'ruv maydonlarini semantik xotira bilan bog'laydi; epizodik eslash va fazoviy mo'ljal.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2006 — The human inferior parietal cortex

description.en: Area OP1 — the posterior-lateral parietal operculum; the human homologue of secondary somatosensory area S2.
description.uz: OP1 maydoni — tepa qopqog'ining orqa-lateral qismi; ikkilamchi somatosensor S2 sohasining odamdagi gomologi.

role.en: Bilateral touch and pain processing, object recognition by touch; relays to the insula.
role.uz: Ikki tomonlama teginish va og'riqni qayta ishlash, buyumni paypaslab tanish; orolchaga uzatadi.

clinical.en: Operculo-insular cortex is a seizure-onset zone producing painful or somatosensory auras; stimulation evokes pain.
clinical.uz: Operkulo-insulyar po'stloq og'riqli yoki somatosensor auralar beruvchi tutqanoq boshlanish zonasi; stimulyatsiyasi og'riq chaqiradi.

sources.title: Eickhoff et al. 2006 — The human parietal operculum

description.en: Area OP2 — the posterior parietal operculum deep in the Sylvian fissure, medial to OP1.
description.uz: OP2 maydoni — Silviy yorig'i chuqurligidagi, OP1 dan medialdagi orqa tepa qopqog'i.

role.en: Core of the human vestibular cortex (parieto-insular vestibular cortex, PIVC) — self-motion and verticality perception.
role.uz: Odam vestibulyar po'stlog'ining asosi (parieto-insulyar vestibulyar po'stloq, PIVC) — o'z harakatini va vertikallikni sezish.

clinical.en: Lesions tilt the perceived visual vertical; stimulation causes vertigo.
clinical.uz: Zararlanishi seziladigan ko'ruv vertikalini og'diradi; stimulyatsiyasi bosh aylanishini chaqiradi.

sources.title: Eickhoff et al. 2006 — The human parietal operculum

description.en: Area OP3 — the anterior-medial parietal operculum next to the insula.
description.uz: OP3 maydoni — orolcha yonidagi tepa qopqog'ining oldingi-medial qismi.

role.en: Ventral somatosensory area (VS) — touch and oral sensation, linked to the insula.
role.uz: Ventral somatosensor soha (VS) — teginish va og'iz sezgisi, orolcha bilan bog'langan.

sources.title: Eickhoff et al. 2006 — The human parietal operculum

description.en: Area OP4 — the anterior-lateral parietal operculum, below the postcentral gyrus.
description.uz: OP4 maydoni — orqa markaziy pushta ostidagi tepa qopqog'ining oldingi-lateral qismi.

role.en: Parietal ventral area (PV) — sensorimotor integration for hand and mouth, links to premotor cortex.
role.uz: Parietal ventral soha (PV) — qo'l va og'iz uchun sensomotor integratsiya, premotor po'stloq bilan bog'langan.

sources.title: Eickhoff et al. 2006 — The human parietal operculum

description.en: The agranular area Ia1 at the anterior-ventral insula (limen insulae) — part of the anterior agranular insular cortex.
description.uz: Orolchaning oldingi-ventral qismidagi (limen insulae) agranulyar Ia1 maydoni — oldingi agranulyar orolcha po'stlog'ining qismi.

role.en: Anterior insula integrates interoceptive signals with emotion and salience — awareness of bodily feelings, disgust, empathy; a core node of the salience network.
role.uz: Oldingi orolcha interoseptiv signallarni emotsiya va ahamiyatlilik bilan birlashtiradi — tana hislarini anglash, jirkanish, empatiya; ahamiyatlilik (salience) tarmog'ining asosiy tuguni.

clinical.en: Early atrophy in behavioural-variant frontotemporal dementia; insular gliomas require care around the lenticulostriate arteries and M2 branches.
clinical.uz: Frontotemporal demensiyaning xulq variantida erta atrofiyalanadi; orolcha gliomalarida lentikulostriar arteriyalar va M2 shoxlari atrofida ehtiyotkorlik talab etiladi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.uz: Oldingi orolchadagi agranulyar Ia2 maydoni — oldingi agranulyar orolcha po'stlog'ining qismi.

description.uz: Id1 maydoni — 1-disgranulyar orolcha maydoni, orqa disgranulyar orolchada, granulyar maydonlar yonida.

role.en: Dysgranular insula is the transition between the posterior sensory and the anterior limbic insula — integrates pain, temperature, visceral and taste signals with emotion.

description.en: Area Ig1 — granular insular area 1 in the posterior insula (long insular gyri).
description.uz: Ig1 maydoni — orqa orolchadagi (uzun orolcha pushtalari) 1-granulyar orolcha maydoni.

role.en: Posterior granular insula is a primary interoceptive cortex: pain, temperature, visceral sensation and somatosensory input from the thalamus (VMpo/VPI).
role.uz: Orqa granulyar orolcha birlamchi interoseptiv po'stloq: og'riq, harorat, visseral sezgi va talamusdan (VMpo/VPI) somatosensor kirish.

clinical.en: Insular seizures mimic frontal or temporal epilepsy (throat constriction, painful paraesthesias); stimulation of Ig areas evokes pain and warmth.
clinical.uz: Orolcha tutqanoqlari peshona yoki chakka epilepsiyasiga o'xshaydi (tomoq qisilishi, og'riqli paresteziyalar); Ig maydonlari stimulyatsiyasi og'riq va issiqlik chaqiradi.

description.en: Area Te 1.0 — the central part of Heschl's gyrus; core primary auditory cortex (koniocortex).
description.uz: Te 1.0 maydoni — Geshl pushtasining markaziy qismi; birlamchi eshituv po'stlog'ining asosi (koniokorteks).

role.en: Receives the acoustic radiation from the medial geniculate body; tonotopic map of sound frequency.
role.uz: Medial tizzasimon tanadan eshituv nurlanishini qabul qiladi; tovush chastotasining tonotopik xaritasi.

clinical.en: Unilateral lesions rarely cause deafness (bilateral input) but impair sound localisation; bilateral lesions give cortical deafness.
clinical.uz: Bir tomonlama zararlanish kamdan-kam karlik beradi (kirish ikki tomonlama), lekin tovush manbasini aniqlashni buzadi; ikki tomonlama zararlanish po'stloq karligini beradi.

sources.title: Morosan et al. 2001 — Human primary auditory cortex

description.en: Area Te 1.1 — the posteromedial part of Heschl's gyrus.
description.uz: Te 1.1 maydoni — Geshl pushtasining orqa-medial qismi.

role.en: Part of the primary auditory core, processing basic sound features.
role.uz: Birlamchi eshituv markazining qismi; tovushning asosiy belgilarini qayta ishlaydi.

sources.title: Morosan et al. 2001 — Human primary auditory cortex

description.en: Area Te 1.2 — the anterolateral part of Heschl's gyrus.
description.uz: Te 1.2 maydoni — Geshl pushtasining oldingi-lateral qismi.

role.en: Transition from the primary auditory core toward the auditory belt; pitch processing.
role.uz: Birlamchi eshituv markazidan eshituv kamariga o'tish; tovush balandligini qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Morosan et al. 2001 — Human primary auditory cortex

description.en: Area Te 2.1 — auditory belt cortex on the planum temporale behind Heschl's gyrus.
description.uz: Te 2.1 maydoni — Geshl pushtasi ortidagi planum temporale'dagi eshituv kamari po'stlog'i.

role.en: Analyses complex sounds and their location; the left planum temporale supports speech sound processing and is usually larger on the left.
role.uz: Murakkab tovushlar va ularning joylashuvini tahlil qiladi; chap planum temporale nutq tovushlarini qayta ishlashni ta'minlaydi va odatda chapda kattaroq.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area Te 2.2 — posterior auditory belt on the planum temporale.
description.uz: Te 2.2 maydoni — planum temporale'dagi orqa eshituv kamari.

role.en: Spatial hearing and the auditory 'where' stream toward parietal cortex.
role.uz: Fazoviy eshitish va tepa po'stlog'i tomon eshituvning 'qayerda' oqimi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area Te 3 — auditory association cortex on the lateral surface of the superior temporal gyrus.
description.uz: Te 3 maydoni — yuqori chakka pushtasining lateral yuzasidagi eshituv assotsiativ po'stlog'i.

role.en: Speech perception and phonological analysis; the posterior left part overlaps Wernicke's area.
role.uz: Nutqni idrok etish va fonologik tahlil; chap orqa qismi Vernike sohasi bilan ustma-ust.

clinical.en: Left posterior STG lesions cause fluent (Wernicke's) aphasia with poor comprehension.
clinical.uz: Chap orqa yuqori chakka pushtasi zararlanishi tushunish buzilgan ravon (Vernike) afaziyasini beradi.

sources.title: Morosan et al. 2005 — Multimodal architectonic mapping of human superior temporal gyrus

description.en: Area TeI — temporo-insular area on the superior temporal plane, medial to Heschl's gyrus at the border with the insula.
description.uz: TeI maydoni — yuqori chakka tekisligida, Geshl pushtasidan medialda orolcha chegarasidagi chakka-orolcha maydoni.

role.en: Links auditory processing with insular (interoceptive, emotional) networks.
role.uz: Eshituv jarayonini orolcha (interoseptiv, emotsional) tarmoqlari bilan bog'laydi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area TI — temporal–insular transition cortex on the planum polare / anterior superior temporal plane.
description.uz: TI maydoni — planum polare / oldingi yuqori chakka tekisligidagi chakka-orolcha o'tish po'stlog'i.

role.en: Auditory–limbic integration, including processing of vocal emotion and music.
role.uz: Eshituv-limbik integratsiya, shu jumladan ovozdagi emotsiya va musiqani qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area TPJ — cytoarchitectonic area at the temporoparietal junction, where the posterior superior temporal gyrus meets the supramarginal gyrus.
description.uz: TPJ maydoni — orqa yuqori chakka pushtasi supramarginal pushta bilan uchrashadigan chakka-tepa tutashuvidagi sitoarxitektonik maydon.

role.en: Theory of mind (right), attention reorienting and multisensory integration of self-location.
role.uz: Boshqalarning fikrini tushunish (o'ngda), diqqatni qayta yo'naltirish va o'z joylashuvining ko'p sezgili integratsiyasi.

clinical.en: Right TPJ lesions contribute to neglect; stimulation can evoke out-of-body experiences.
clinical.uz: O'ng TPJ zararlanishi e'tiborsizlikka hissa qo'shadi; stimulyatsiyasi 'tanadan tashqari' kechinmani chaqirishi mumkin.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area STS1 — cytoarchitectonic area in the upper bank of the superior temporal sulcus.
description.uz: STS1 maydoni — yuqori chakka egatining yuqori devoridagi sitoarxitektonik maydon.

role.en: Voice and speech processing (temporal voice areas); audiovisual integration.
role.uz: Ovoz va nutqni qayta ishlash (chakka ovoz sohalari); eshituv-ko'ruv integratsiyasi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area STS2 — cytoarchitectonic area in the lower bank of the superior temporal sulcus.
description.uz: STS2 maydoni — yuqori chakka egatining pastki devoridagi sitoarxitektonik maydon.

role.en: Perception of biological motion, gaze and facial expression — social perception.
role.uz: Biologik harakat, nigoh va yuz ifodasini idrok etish — ijtimoiy idrok.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area FG1 — posterior fusiform gyrus, medial part (next to the collateral sulcus).
description.uz: FG1 maydoni — duksimon pushtaning orqa qismi, medial bo'lagi (kollateral egat yonida).

role.en: Early ventral visual processing — responds to places, scenes and large objects (medial fusiform).
role.uz: Erta ventral ko'ruv jarayoni — joylar, manzaralar va katta buyumlarga javob beradi (medial duksimon).

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2013 — Cytoarchitectonical analysis of the posterior fusiform gyrus

description.en: Area FG2 — posterior fusiform gyrus, lateral part (next to the occipitotemporal sulcus).
description.uz: FG2 maydoni — duksimon pushtaning orqa qismi, lateral bo'lagi (ensa-chakka egati yonida).

role.en: Object and face processing; overlaps the occipital face area / posterior fusiform face patch and, on the left, the posterior visual word form area.
role.uz: Buyum va yuzlarni qayta ishlash; ensa yuz sohasi / orqa duksimon yuz qismi bilan, chapda esa orqa ko'ruv so'z shakli sohasi bilan ustma-ust.

sources.title: Caspers et al. 2013 — Cytoarchitectonical analysis of the posterior fusiform gyrus

description.en: Area FG3 — mid-fusiform gyrus, medial part, anterior to FG1.
description.uz: FG3 maydoni — duksimon pushtaning o'rta qismi, medial bo'lagi, FG1 oldida.

role.en: Higher-level scene and object category processing.
role.uz: Manzara va buyum toifalarini yuqori darajada qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area FG4 — mid-fusiform gyrus, lateral part, anterior to FG2.
description.uz: FG4 maydoni — duksimon pushtaning o'rta qismi, lateral bo'lagi, FG2 oldida.

role.en: Contains the fusiform face area (right-dominant) and the visual word form area (left-dominant).
role.uz: Duksimon yuz sohasi (o'ngda dominant) va ko'ruv so'z shakli sohasini (chapda dominant) o'z ichiga oladi.

clinical.en: Right lesions cause prosopagnosia (inability to recognise faces); left lesions cause pure alexia (letter-by-letter reading).
clinical.uz: O'ng tomon zararlanishi prozopagnoziya (yuzlarni tanimaslik), chap tomon zararlanishi sof aleksiya (harfma-harf o'qish) beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area FG5 — anterior fusiform gyrus.
description.uz: FG5 maydoni — duksimon pushtaning oldingi qismi.

role.en: Links visual object representations with semantic knowledge in the anterior temporal lobe.
role.uz: Ko'ruv buyum tasavvurlarini oldingi chakka bo'lagidagi semantik bilim bilan bog'laydi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area OTS1 — cytoarchitectonic area in the occipitotemporal sulcus.
description.uz: OTS1 maydoni — ensa-chakka egatidagi sitoarxitektonik maydon.

role.en: Ventral visual stream processing of words and objects between the fusiform and inferior temporal gyri.
role.uz: Duksimon va pastki chakka pushtalari orasida so'z va buyumlarni ventral ko'ruv oqimida qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area CoS1 — cytoarchitectonic area in the collateral sulcus.
description.uz: CoS1 maydoni — kollateral egatdagi sitoarxitektonik maydon.

role.en: Scene and place processing, bordering the parahippocampal place area.
role.uz: Manzara va joylarni qayta ishlash; parahippokampal joy sohasiga tutashgan.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area Ph1 — cytoarchitectonic area 1 of the posterior parahippocampal gyrus.
description.uz: Ph1 maydoni — gippokamp yoni pushtasi orqa qismining 1-sitoarxitektonik maydoni.

role.en: Posterior parahippocampal cortex processes scenes and spatial context (parahippocampal place area) and relays them to the entorhinal cortex.
role.uz: Orqa parahippokampal po'stloq manzara va fazoviy kontekstni qayta ishlaydi (parahippokampal joy sohasi) va ularni entorinal po'stloqqa uzatadi.

clinical.en: Posterior cerebral artery infarcts involving this region cause topographical disorientation.
clinical.uz: Bu sohani qamragan orqa miya arteriyasi infarktlari topografik adashish beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area Ph2 — cytoarchitectonic area 2 of the posterior parahippocampal gyrus.
description.uz: Ph2 maydoni — gippokamp yoni pushtasi orqa qismining 2-sitoarxitektonik maydoni.

role.en: Posterior parahippocampal cortex processes scenes and spatial context (parahippocampal place area) and relays them to the entorhinal cortex.
role.uz: Orqa parahippokampal po'stloq manzara va fazoviy kontekstni qayta ishlaydi (parahippokampal joy sohasi) va ularni entorinal po'stloqqa uzatadi.

description.en: Area PirT — temporal part of the piriform cortex on the dorsomedial surface of the uncus, next to the amygdala.
description.uz: PirT maydoni — noksimon po'stloqning chakka qismi; unkusning dorsomedial yuzasida, amigdala yonida.

role.en: Primary olfactory cortex: receives the lateral olfactory tract and identifies odours.
role.uz: Birlamchi hid po'stlog'i: lateral hid traktini qabul qiladi va hidlarni aniqlaydi.

clinical.en: Olfactory (uncinate) auras of mesial temporal seizures arise here; highly epileptogenic in animal models.
clinical.uz: Mezial chakka tutqanoqlarining hid (unsinat) auralari shu yerda paydo bo'ladi; hayvon modellarida yuqori epileptogen.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area PirTB — temporobasal part of the piriform cortex, extending along the basal temporal surface.
description.uz: PirTB maydoni — noksimon po'stloqning chakka-bazal qismi, chakka bo'lagining bazal yuzasi bo'ylab cho'zilgan.

role.en: Olfactory processing linked with the amygdala and entorhinal cortex — emotional and memory aspects of smell.
role.uz: Amigdala va entorinal po'stloq bilan bog'langan hid jarayoni — hidning emotsional va xotira jihatlari.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hOc1 — primary visual cortex (V1, Brodmann area 17, striate cortex) on the banks of the calcarine sulcus, recognisable by the stria of Gennari.
description.uz: hOc1 maydoni — kalkarin egat devorlaridagi birlamchi ko'ruv po'stlog'i (V1, Brodmann 17-maydoni, chiziqli po'stloq); Jennari chizig'i bilan tanilgan.

role.en: Receives the optic radiation from the lateral geniculate body; retinotopic map of the contralateral visual hemifield, with the macula at the occipital pole.
role.uz: Lateral tizzasimon tanadan ko'ruv nurlanishini qabul qiladi; qarama-qarshi ko'ruv yarim maydonining retinotopik xaritasi, makula ensa qutbida.

clinical.en: PCA infarcts give contralateral homonymous hemianopia, often with macular sparing (dual MCA/PCA supply of the pole); bilateral damage causes cortical blindness (Anton syndrome if denied).
clinical.uz: Orqa miya arteriyasi infarktlari qarama-qarshi gomonim gemianopiya beradi, ko'pincha makula saqlanadi (qutbning MCA/PCA qo'sh ta'minoti); ikki tomonlama zararlanish po'stloq ko'rligini beradi (inkor etilsa — Anton sindromi).

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2000 — Brodmann's areas 17 and 18 brought into stereotaxic space

description.en: Area hOc2 — secondary visual cortex (V2, Brodmann area 18), a belt surrounding V1.
description.uz: hOc2 maydoni — V1 ni o'rab turgan ikkilamchi ko'ruv po'stlog'i (V2, Brodmann 18-maydoni).

role.en: Processes contours, texture and illusory edges; distributes V1 output to dorsal and ventral streams.
role.uz: Konturlar, tekstura va xayoliy qirralarni qayta ishlaydi; V1 chiqishini dorsal va ventral oqimlarga taqsimlaydi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2000 — Brodmann's areas 17 and 18 brought into stereotaxic space

description.en: Area hOc3d — dorsal V3 on the cuneus, above V2.
description.uz: hOc3d maydoni — kuneusdagi dorsal V3, V2 ustida.

role.en: Represents the lower visual field; motion and form processing in the dorsal stream.
role.uz: Pastki ko'ruv maydonini aks ettiradi; dorsal oqimda harakat va shaklni qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hOc4d — dorsal occipital area (V3A) on the cuneus / transverse occipital sulcus.
description.uz: hOc4d maydoni — kuneus / ko'ndalang ensa egatidagi dorsal ensa maydoni (V3A).

role.en: Motion and depth (stereo) processing in the dorsal visual stream.
role.uz: Dorsal ko'ruv oqimida harakat va chuqurlikni (stereo) qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hOc3v — ventral V3 (VP) on the lingual gyrus, below V2.
description.uz: hOc3v maydoni — tilsimon pushtadagi ventral V3 (VP), V2 ostida.

role.en: Represents the upper visual field; early ventral-stream form processing.
role.uz: Yuqori ko'ruv maydonini aks ettiradi; erta ventral oqimda shaklni qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Rottschy et al. 2007 — Ventral visual cortex in humans

description.en: Area hOc4v — ventral occipital area (V4) on the lingual and posterior fusiform gyri.
description.uz: hOc4v maydoni — tilsimon va orqa duksimon pushtalardagi ventral ensa maydoni (V4).

role.en: Colour and intermediate form (shape) processing.
role.uz: Rang va oraliq darajadagi shaklni qayta ishlash.

clinical.en: Lesions of the ventral occipital cortex cause cerebral achromatopsia (loss of colour vision) in the contralateral hemifield.
clinical.uz: Ventral ensa po'stlog'i zararlanishi qarama-qarshi yarim maydonda miya axromatopsiyasi (rang ko'rishning yo'qolishi) beradi.

sources.title: Rottschy et al. 2007 — Ventral visual cortex in humans

description.en: Area hOc4la — anterior lateral occipital area (LO2) on the lateral occipital surface.
description.uz: hOc4la maydoni — lateral ensa yuzasidagi oldingi lateral ensa maydoni (LO2).

role.en: Part of the lateral occipital complex — object shape recognition independent of size or position.
role.uz: Lateral ensa kompleksining qismi — o'lcham yoki joylashuvdan qat'i nazar buyum shaklini tanish.

clinical.en: Bilateral lateral occipital damage causes visual form agnosia.
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama lateral ensa zararlanishi ko'ruv shakl agnoziyasini beradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hOc4lp — posterior lateral occipital area (LO1).
description.uz: hOc4lp maydoni — orqa lateral ensa maydoni (LO1).

role.en: Early shape and contour orientation processing feeding the lateral occipital complex.
role.uz: Lateral ensa kompleksini ta'minlovchi erta shakl va kontur yo'nalishini qayta ishlash.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hOc5 — the human motion area V5/MT+ at the lateral occipito-temporal junction, near the ascending limb of the inferior temporal sulcus.
description.uz: hOc5 maydoni — lateral ensa-chakka tutashuvidagi, pastki chakka egatining ko'tariluvchi shoxi yaqinidagi odam harakat sohasi V5/MT+.

role.en: Perception of visual motion direction and speed; guides smooth-pursuit eye movements.
role.uz: Ko'ruv harakatining yo'nalishi va tezligini idrok etish; silliq kuzatuvchi ko'z harakatlarini yo'naltiradi.

clinical.en: Bilateral damage causes akinetopsia (motion blindness).
clinical.uz: Ikki tomonlama zararlanish akinetopsiya (harakat ko'rligi) beradi.

sources.title: Malikovic et al. 2007 — Cytoarchitectonic analysis of area hOc5 (V5/MT+)

description.en: Area hOc6 — dorsal occipital area in the parieto-occipital sulcus (human V6 region).
description.uz: hOc6 maydoni — tepa-ensa egatidagi dorsal ensa maydoni (odamdagi V6 sohasi).

role.en: Wide-field and self-motion (optic flow) processing; represents the peripheral visual field.
role.uz: Keng maydonli va o'z harakatini (optik oqim) qayta ishlash; periferik ko'ruv maydonini aks ettiradi.

sources.title: Amunts et al. 2020 — Julich-Brain: a 3D probabilistic atlas of the human brain's cytoarchitecture

description.en: Area hPO1 — parieto-occipital area 1 in the anterior bank of the parieto-occipital sulcus (human V6A region).
description.uz: hPO1 maydoni — tepa-ensa egatining oldingi devoridagi tepa-ensa 1-maydoni (odamdagi V6A sohasi).

role.en: Visuomotor control of reaching and grasping toward peripheral targets.
role.uz: Periferik nishonlarga cho'zilish va ushlashning ko'ruv-harakat nazorati.

description.en: GapMap Frontal-I.1 — frontal cortex (part 1 of GapMap Frontal-I) not yet covered by a cytoarchitectonic map. Julich-Brain fills such gaps with provisional 'GapMaps' so the atlas covers the whole cortex; each is replaced as new areas are mapped.
description.uz: GapMap Frontal-I.1 — hali sitoarxitektonik xarita bilan qoplanmagan peshona po'stlog'i (GapMap Frontal-I ning 1-qismi). Julich-Brain atlas butun po'stloqni qoplashi uchun bunday bo'shliqlarni vaqtinchalik 'GapMap'lar bilan to'ldiradi; yangi maydonlar xaritalangan sari ular almashtiriladi.

role.en: Not a functional unit — it marks cortex whose areal boundaries are still being studied.
role.uz: Funksional birlik emas — maydon chegaralari hali o'rganilayotgan po'stloqni belgilaydi.
